definition_zh: 使复杂化；使难懂；使恶化
definition_en: to make something more difficult to understand or deal with
core_image: 本来一条笔直的线，被不断打结，越绕越乱
scene: 本来只是一件小事，他一解释反而添了乱。Do not complicate a simple apology with long excuses.
sceneCN: 这里 complicate 指「使复杂化」（第 1 个义项：让事情变得更难处理）；句意是别用冗长的借口把一句简单的道歉弄复杂。

pos.zh: 使复杂化；使难懂；使恶化

senses.title: Make harder to follow
senses.definition: to make something harder to understand by adding parts
senses.definitionCN: 通过增加内容让某事更难理解
senses.example: Extra rules only complicate the game.
senses.exampleCN: 多余的规则只会让游戏变复杂。
senses.why: Every added part becomes one more thing the mind must hold.
senses.whyCN: 每增加一部分，脑子就要多记住一样东西。

senses.title: Make a problem worse
senses.definition: to make a bad situation or illness more serious
senses.definitionCN: 使糟糕的处境或病情变得更严重
senses.example: Stress can complicate recovery from illness.
senses.exampleCN: 压力会让病后恢复变得更棘手。
senses.why: A second trouble arriving on top of the first multiplies the burden.
senses.whyCN: 第二个麻烦压在第一个之上，负担就成倍增加。

senses.title: Twist things together
senses.definition: to fold or twist things together so they are hard to separate
senses.definitionCN: 把东西折叠或缠绕在一起，难以分开
senses.example: The wires were complicated into a tight knot.
senses.exampleCN: 电线被缠成了一个紧结。
senses.why: The oldest sense is physical folding, and confusion is folding in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是物理上的折叠，而困惑就是脑子里的折叠。

intro.en: Complicate comes from Latin complicare, to fold together, and first described things twisted into one another.
intro.cn: complicate 来自拉丁语 complicare，意为折在一起，最初描述互相缠结的东西。

items.en: Com- meant together and plicare meant to fold.
items.cn: com- 表示一起，plicare 表示折叠。

items.en: Complicare described folding several layers into one bundle.
items.cn: complicare 描述把好几层折成一捆。

items.en: Old French compliquer carried the idea into everyday speech.
items.cn: 古法语 compliquer 把这个意思带入日常语言。

items.en: English complicate first meant to intertwine or entangle.
items.cn: 英语 complicate 最初指使交织、使缠结。

items.en: It now means to make a matter harder to understand or to handle.
items.cn: 如今它指让事情更难理解或更难处理。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that share the shape of complicate, and the meaning group names other ways of making a matter hard.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 complicate 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他把事弄难的说法。

entries.definition: made of many connected parts
a problem that makes a situation worse
hard to understand or deal with
to make someone unable to think clearly
to twist things together so they are hard to separate
to make something confusing or disordered

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with folded cloth, then move to tangled wires and to problems that grow heavier.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从折起的布开始，再走到缠住的电线与越压越重的问题。

normal.en: Com- is together and plic- is fold, so to complicate is to fold things into each other.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，plic- 是折叠，所以 complicate 就是把东西折到一起。

normal.en: A simple task plus one extra rule equals a complicated task.
normal.cn: 简单的任务加一条多余的规则，就变成复杂的任务。

normal.en: A knot is complicate made visible in a piece of string.
normal.cn: 一个结，就是 complicate 在一根绳子上的可见形态。

normal.en: When an illness is complicated, a second problem has joined the first.
normal.cn: 病情被 complicate 时，就是第二个问题加入了第一个。

normal.en: Keep the promise simple and you never need to complicate it.
normal.cn: 把承诺保持简单，就永远不必把它弄复杂。

abstract.en: Picture one straight road that keeps splitting into smaller paths.
abstract.cn: 想象一条直路不断分出更小的岔路。

abstract.en: Picture a ball of string pulled by two hands at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一团线被两只手同时拉扯。

abstract.en: Picture a short answer buried under pages of notes.
abstract.cn: 想象一个简短答案被成页的注释埋住。

examples.en: The new rules only complicate the process for everyone.
examples.cn: 新规则只是让每个人的流程都变复杂。

examples.en: Travel delays were complicated by heavy snow.
examples.cn: 旅途的延误因大雪而更加棘手。

examples.en: Please do not complicate matters with more forms.
examples.cn: 请不要再拿更多表格把事情弄复杂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 complicate 记成 com（一起）加 plic（折叠）：把好几层折到一起，事情就变复杂了。

root: 源自拉丁语 complicare（com 一起 + plicare 折叠），本义是把东西折在一起，后引申为使事情交织、难懂与恶化。

sensesIntro.en: From folded cloth, to a tangled knot, and finally to a problem that grows heavier.
sensesIntro.cn: 从折起的布，到缠成的结，最后到越压越重的问题。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one straight line folded again and again until it is a knot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条直线被反复折叠，最后成了一个结。

branches.en: Adding parts is the everyday way to complicate a task.
branches.cn: 增加内容是把任务弄复杂的日常方式。

branches.en: A second trouble makes the first one heavier.
branches.cn: 第二个麻烦会让第一个更沉重。

branches.en: The physical knot is the oldest picture behind the word.
branches.cn: 物理上的结，是这个词最古老的画面。

branches.en: Both senses add a layer that did not need to be there.
branches.cn: 两个义项都添了一层本不必要的负担。

branches.en: A tangled knot and a worsened problem both resist easy undoing.
branches.cn: 缠死的结与恶化的难题都难以轻松解开。

intro.en: Complicate is built on Latin com-, together, plus the base plic-, to fold.
intro.cn: complicate 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与词基 plic-（折叠）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin fold base plic- also appears in complex and multiply.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的折叠词基 plic- 也出现在 complex 与 multiply 中。

items.meaning: to make something harder to follow
items.example: Long forms complicate the application.
items.exampleCN: 冗长的表格让申请变复杂。

items.example: The machine has a complicated design.
items.exampleCN: 这台机器的设计很复杂。

items.example: A complicating factor appeared late.
items.exampleCN: 晚些时候出现了一个使情况恶化的因素。

items.example: The surgery had one small complication.
items.exampleCN: 手术出现了一个小并发症。

items.example: The doctor watched for complications.
items.exampleCN: 医生留心观察并发症。

items.example: It was an uncomplicated birth.
items.exampleCN: 那是一次顺利的分娩。

items.example: The brain is a complex organ.
items.exampleCN: 大脑是一个复杂的器官。

items.example: The complexity of the law surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 法律的复杂性让我们吃惊。

definition_zh: 组成部分；部件；成分；要素；组成的
definition_en: one of the parts that together make a whole machine, system or idea
core_image: 一台拆开的收音机，桌上散着一颗颗零件
scene: 修车师傅把拆下的零件按顺序摆在布上。Each component must go back in its exact place.
sceneCN: 这里 component 指「组成部分」（第 1 个义项：构成整体的部件）；句意是每个零件都必须装回它原来的确切位置。

senses.title: A part of a machine
senses.definition: one of several parts that make up a machine or device
senses.definitionCN: 组成机器或装置的若干部分之一
senses.example: The factory makes engine components.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂生产发动机部件。
senses.why: A machine can be taken apart into pieces, and each piece keeps a clear job.
senses.whyCN: 机器可以拆成零件，而每个零件都有明确的职责。

senses.title: An element of a whole
senses.definition: one part of a larger system, plan or idea
senses.definitionCN: 更大系统、计划或想法中的一部分
senses.example: Trust is a key component of teamwork.
senses.exampleCN: 信任是团队合作的关键要素。
senses.why: Not every part is metal; a system can be held together by an idea.
senses.whyCN: 并非每个部分都是金属做的；一个系统也能靠理念维系。

senses.title: Serving as one part
senses.definition: used to describe a part that helps to form a whole
senses.definitionCN: 用来描述有助于构成整体的部分
senses.example: The component parts are listed on the box.
senses.exampleCN: 各个组成部件都列在盒子上。
senses.why: The adjective simply turns the noun into a label for the part itself.
senses.whyCN: 形容词用法只是把这个名词变成对部件本身的标注。

intro.en: Component comes from Latin componere, to put together, and names a part that has been placed into a whole.
intro.cn: component 来自拉丁语 componere，意为放在一起，指被放进整体里的一个部分。

items.en: Componere joined com-, together, with ponere, to put.
items.cn: componere 由 com-（一起）与 ponere（放置）组合而成。

items.en: A componens was a part that entered a larger whole.
items.cn: componens 指进入更大整体的一个部分。

items.en: French composant named an element that enters a mixture.
items.cn: 法语 composant 指进入混合物的一个成分。

items.en: English component first described one part of a machine.
items.cn: 英语 component 最初指机器的一个部件。

items.en: It now covers parts of machines, systems and ideas alike.
items.cn: 如今它同样覆盖机器、系统与想法的组成部分。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that echo the ending of component, and the meaning group names other words for a part of a whole.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 component 词尾相近的词，近义组列出其他表示整体的部分的词。

entries.definition: a person who competes against you
a person who argues in favour of something
a thing made of two or more parts
a piece of a whole
one basic part of something larger
a single thing that forms part of a whole

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a machine laid out on a table, then move to systems and to the adjective label.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从摊在桌上的机器开始，再走到系统与形容词用法。

normal.en: Com- is together and pon- is put, so a component is something put in with the rest.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，pon- 是放置，component 就是和其他部分放在一起的东西。

normal.en: Take the radio apart and every component still looks useful.
normal.cn: 把收音机拆开，每个零件看起来仍然有用。

normal.en: A team has components too, and trust is one of them.
normal.cn: 团队也有组成部分，信任就是其中之一。

normal.en: Component parts is the phrase you see on the side of a box.
normal.cn: 盒子上写的那句话就是 component parts。

normal.en: One component can break the whole machine if it fails.
normal.cn: 一个部件出问题，就可能让整台机器停摆。

abstract.en: Picture a clock face opened to show its tiny wheels.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟被打开，露出里面细小的齿轮。

abstract.en: Picture a recipe where each ingredient does one job.
abstract.cn: 想象一份食谱，每种材料各司其职。

abstract.en: Picture one brick missing from a long wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一面长墙上缺了一块砖。

examples.en: Each component was tested before assembly.
examples.cn: 每个部件在装配前都经过测试。

examples.en: Cost is only one component of the decision.
examples.cn: 成本只是这个决定的一个组成部分。

examples.en: The component parts arrived in separate boxes.
examples.cn: 各个组成部件分装在几个盒子里运到。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 component 记成 com（一起）加 pon（放）加 ent：被一起放进整体里的那一块，就是部件。

root: 源自拉丁语 componere（com 一起 + ponere 放置），本义是被放入整体的部分，后指部件、成分与要素。

sensesIntro.en: From a metal part in a machine, to an element of a plan, and finally to the adjective that labels the part.
sensesIntro.cn: 从机器里的金属件，到计划中的要素，最后到标注部件的形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a radio taken apart on a table, every part in its own place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一台收音机被拆在桌上，每个零件各占一处。

branches.en: The machine sense is the most physical and the easiest to picture.
branches.cn: 机器义项最具体，也最容易想象。

branches.en: A plan or a team can also be built from parts.
branches.cn: 计划和团队同样可以由部分组成。

branches.en: The adjective simply labels a part as belonging to a whole.
branches.cn: 形容词用法只是标注某部分属于整体。

branches.en: Hardware and ideas are both assembled from smaller pieces.
branches.cn: 硬件和理念都由更小的部分组装而成。

branches.en: Component parts is the same idea used as a description.
branches.cn: component parts 只是把同一个意思用作描述。

intro.en: Component is built on Latin com-, together, plus ponere, to put, with the ending -ent.
intro.cn: component 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、ponere（放置）与词尾 -ent 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base pon- also gives compose, position and deposit.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 pon- 还给出 compose、position 与 deposit 这些词。

items.example: The kit contains fifty components.
items.exampleCN: 这套工具包含五十个部件。

items.example: The factory supplies electronic componentry.
items.exampleCN: 这家工厂供应电子零部件。

items.example: The study uses a componential analysis.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究采用成分分析法。

items.example: The two systems differ componentially.
items.exampleCN: 这两个系统在成分上有所不同。

items.example: Ten members compose the committee.
items.exampleCN: 十名成员组成这个委员会。

items.example: The composer revised the ending.
items.exampleCN: 作曲家修改了结尾。

items.meaning: the way parts are put together
items.example: The composition of the soil matters.
items.exampleCN: 土壤的构成很重要。

items.example: The bridge uses a composite material.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥使用一种复合材料。

definition_zh: 组成；构成；创作；使镇静
definition_en: to form something by putting parts together, or to write music or a letter
core_image: 一个人把散落的音符一个个摆上五线谱
scene: 演出前，作曲家在后台安静地写完最后一段旋律。She needed a quiet room to compose the final movement.
sceneCN: 这里 compose 指「创作乐曲」（第 2 个义项：写音乐或文章）；句意是她需要一个安静的房间来写最后一个乐章。

senses.title: Put parts into a whole
senses.definition: to combine parts so that they form a whole
senses.definitionCN: 把各部分组合起来形成一个整体
senses.example: Ten chapters compose the whole book.
senses.exampleCN: 十个章节构成整本书。
senses.why: The parts come first, and the whole appears only when they are placed together.
senses.whyCN: 部分先存在，只有把它们放在一起，整体才出现。

senses.title: Write music or text
senses.definition: to write music, a poem or a letter
senses.definitionCN: 创作音乐、诗歌或书信
senses.example: He composed the song in one night.
senses.exampleCN: 他一夜之间写成了这首歌。
senses.why: Notes and words are also parts, and the writer places them in order.
senses.whyCN: 音符和文字也是部分，作者把它们按顺序摆好。

senses.title: Calm yourself down
senses.definition: to make yourself calm after strong feeling
senses.definitionCN: 在强烈情绪之后使自己平静下来
senses.example: She took a breath to compose herself.
senses.exampleCN: 她吸了一口气让自己镇定下来。
senses.why: To compose the mind is to put its scattered parts back in order.
senses.whyCN: 整理心绪，就是把散乱的部分重新放回秩序里。

intro.en: Compose comes from Latin componere, to put together, and reached English through Old French composer.
intro.cn: compose 来自拉丁语 componere（放在一起），经古法语 composer 进入英语。

items.en: Componere joined com-, together, with ponere, to put.
items.cn: componere 由 com-（一起）与 ponere（放置）组合而成。

items.en: Compositus described something neatly arranged from parts.
items.cn: compositus 描述由各部分整齐组合而成的东西。

items.en: Old French composer meant to put in order or to settle.
items.cn: 古法语 composer 意为整理、安排或平息。

items.en: English compose first meant to arrange or to form from parts.
items.cn: 英语 compose 最初指安排或由部分组成。

items.en: It grew to cover writing music and calming the mind.
items.cn: 后来它扩展到创作音乐与平复心绪。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to compose, and the meaning group names other ways of putting a whole together.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 compose 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他把整体拼起来的说法。

entries.definition: to consist of particular parts
decayed plant material used to feed soil
a calm and controlled state of mind
to make something new
to put things in a neat order
to make or shape something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with parts laid on a desk, then move to music and to a mind put back in order.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从摊在桌上的部分开始，再走到音乐与重新整理好的心绪。

normal.en: Com- is together and pos- is put, so compose is to put things together.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，pos- 是放置，compose 就是把东西放到一起。

normal.en: A composer puts notes together the way a builder puts bricks together.
normal.cn: 作曲家摆放音符，就像砌工摆放砖块。

normal.en: Be composed of means the parts are already in place.
normal.cn: be composed of 表示各部分已经放好。

normal.en: Compose yourself is to gather your scattered feelings.
normal.cn: compose yourself 就是把自己散乱的情绪收拢起来。

normal.en: A composed person looks as if everything is in its place.
normal.cn: 一个 composed 的人，看上去一切各就各位。

abstract.en: Picture a hand setting each chess piece on its square.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把每枚棋子放上它的格子。

abstract.en: Picture five lines of music slowly filling with notes.
abstract.cn: 想象五行乐谱慢慢被音符填满。

abstract.en: Picture a messy desk sorted into neat piles.
abstract.cn: 想象一张乱桌被整理成整齐的几摞。

examples.en: Ten small states compose the whole union.
examples.cn: 十个小州组成整个联邦。

examples.en: She composed the letter carefully before sending it.
examples.cn: 她仔细写好信才寄出去。

examples.en: He paused to compose himself before speaking.
examples.cn: 他停顿一下让自己镇定，然后才开口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 compose 记成 com（一起）加 pose（摆放）：把各部分摆到一起，就是组成，也可以指作曲。

root: 源自拉丁语 componere（com 一起 + ponere 放置），本义是放在一起，后引申为组成、创作与使心绪安定。

sensesIntro.en: From parts arranged into a whole, to notes arranged into a song, and finally to a mind arranged into calm.
sensesIntro.cn: 从部分排成整体，到音符排成歌曲，最后到心绪排成平静。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand placing each part in its place until a whole appears.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把每个部分放到位，直到整体出现。

branches.en: The basic sense is simply parts placed together.
branches.cn: 基本义项就是各部分被放在一起。

branches.en: Writing music is the same act with notes instead of bricks.
branches.cn: 写音乐只是把砖块换成音符的同一个动作。

branches.en: Calming the mind is composing its scattered pieces.
branches.cn: 让心平静，就是把散乱的碎片重新组合。

branches.en: Both senses depend on choosing an order.
branches.cn: 两个义项都取决于选好一种顺序。

branches.en: A finished song and a calm face both show ordered parts.
branches.cn: 完成的歌曲与平静的面容都显出有序的部分。

intro.en: Compose is built on Latin com-, together, plus ponere, to put, through the French form composer.
intro.cn: compose 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 ponere（放置）构成，经法语 composer 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base pos- or pon- also appears in position, deposit and component.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 pos- 或 pon- 也出现在 position、deposit 与 component 中。

items.example: A thin layer composes the outer shell.
items.exampleCN: 一层薄薄的物质构成外壳。

items.example: The panel is composed of six experts.
items.exampleCN: 这个小组由六位专家组成。

items.example: He is composing a new suite.
items.exampleCN: 他正在创作一组新组曲。

items.example: The composer lives in Vienna.
items.exampleCN: 这位作曲家住在维也纳。

items.example: The composition of the team changed.
items.exampleCN: 团队的构成变了。

items.example: They used a composite photograph.
items.exampleCN: 他们用了一张合成照片。

items.example: She kept her composure throughout.
items.exampleCN: 她全程保持镇定。

items.example: Leaves decompose slowly in cold weather.
items.exampleCN: 天冷时叶子分解得慢。

items.example: Heat speeds up decomposition.
items.exampleCN: 高温会加快分解。

definition_zh: 化合物；复合物；复合词；复合的；使加重
definition_en: a substance or thing made of two or more parts, or to make a problem worse
core_image: 两种粉末倒进同一只碗里，搅成一种新东西
scene: 实验室里，两种液体混合后颜色立刻变深。The compound turned dark as soon as the two liquids met.
sceneCN: 这里 compound 指「化合物」（第 1 个义项：由两种以上元素化合成的物质）；句意是两种液体一相遇，这种化合物立刻变暗。

senses.title: A substance of joined elements
senses.definition: a substance formed when two or more elements join chemically
senses.definitionCN: 两种或更多元素经化学结合形成的物质
senses.example: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
senses.exampleCN: 水是氢和氧的化合物。
senses.why: Chemistry shows that simple elements can join and lose their separate natures.
senses.whyCN: 化学证明简单元素能结合，并失去各自原来的性质。

senses.title: A thing of joined parts
senses.definition: something made by combining two or more parts
senses.definitionCN: 由两个或更多部分组合而成的事物
senses.example: Blackboard is a compound of black and board.
senses.exampleCN: blackboard 是 black 与 board 组合成的复合词。
senses.why: Language and buildings alike can be built by joining simple units.
senses.whyCN: 语言和建筑一样，都能靠连接简单单位来搭建。

senses.title: Make a problem worse
senses.definition: to make a bad situation or difficulty worse
senses.definitionCN: 使糟糕的处境或困难变得更严重
senses.example: Delay only compounded the damage.
senses.exampleCN: 拖延只会让损失加重。
senses.why: One harm added to another is a kind of chemical joining of troubles.
senses.whyCN: 一种伤害叠加到另一种上，就像麻烦的化合。

intro.en: Compound comes from Latin componere, to put together, and reached English through Old French compondre.
intro.cn: compound 来自拉丁语 componere（放在一起），经古法语 compondre 进入英语。

items.en: Componere meant to place several things together.
items.cn: componere 意为把几样东西放在一起。

items.en: Compositum named a thing built from separate parts.
items.cn: compositum 指由分开的部分构成的东西。

items.en: Old French compondre used the word for mixed substances.
items.cn: 古法语 compondre 用它指混合而成的物质。

items.en: English compound first described a mixture or a joined word.
items.cn: 英语 compound 最初指混合物或合成的词。

items.en: The verb sense of making trouble worse came later.
items.cn: 表示使麻烦加重的动词义项是后来出现的。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to compound, and the meaning group names other mixtures and joined things.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 compound 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他混合物与合成物。

entries.definition: to form a whole by putting parts together
a collection of facts or writings
one part of a larger whole
a combination of different things
two or more things joined together
made by combining different parts

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two powders in one bowl, then move to joined words and to trouble piled on trouble.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一只碗里的两种粉末开始，再走到合成的词与层层叠加的麻烦。

normal.en: Com- is together and pound comes from ponere, to put, so a compound is things put together.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，pound 源自 ponere（放置），compound 就是放在一起的东西。

normal.en: A compound word is two words wearing one coat.
normal.cn: 复合词就是两个词合穿一件外套。

normal.en: Compound interest lets interest earn its own interest.
normal.cn: 复利让利息自己也生出利息。

normal.en: A compound sentence joins two ideas with a link.
normal.cn: 复合句用一个连接把两个想法接起来。

normal.en: Delay compounds a problem because it adds one more cost.
normal.cn: 拖延会加重问题，因为它又添了一项代价。

abstract.en: Picture two clear liquids turning one deep colour.
abstract.cn: 想象两种清澈的液体变成一种深色。

abstract.en: Picture two words glued into a single label.
abstract.cn: 想象两个词粘成一张标签。

abstract.en: Picture a small debt growing a second layer overnight.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔小债一夜之间长出新的一层。

examples.en: Salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.
examples.cn: 盐是钠和氯的化合物。

examples.en: The word sunshine is a compound.
examples.cn: sunshine 是一个复合词。

examples.en: His silence only compounded her worry.
examples.cn: 他的沉默只是让她的担忧更重。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 compound 记成 com（一起）加 pound（放）：几样东西放到一起，就是化合物，也能表示麻烦叠加。

root: 源自拉丁语 componere（com 一起 + ponere 放置），本义是放在一起，后指化合物、复合物，并引申为使问题加重。

sensesIntro.en: From elements joined in a lab, to words joined on a page, and finally to troubles joined into a heavier burden.
sensesIntro.cn: 从实验室里结合的元素，到纸面上合成的词，最后到叠加成更重负担的麻烦。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two powders poured into one bowl and stirred into a new thing.
core.cn: 核心意象：两种粉末倒进同一只碗，搅成一种新东西。

branches.en: Chemistry gives the clearest picture of a compound.
branches.cn: 化学提供了 compound 最清晰的画面。

branches.en: Words and objects can also be compounds of parts.
branches.cn: 词语和物件也可以是部分的复合物。

branches.en: The verb sense treats troubles as things that combine.
branches.cn: 动词义项把麻烦当作会结合的东西。

branches.en: Both senses join simple units into something new.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把简单单位结合成新东西。

branches.en: A joined word and an added problem both grow by addition.
branches.cn: 合成的词和叠加的问题都靠添加而增长。

intro.en: Compound is built on Latin com-, together, plus ponere, to put, through the French form compondre.
intro.cn: compound 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 ponere（放置）构成，经法语 compondre 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The same Latin base gives compose, component and composition.
latinIntro.cn: 同一个拉丁词基还给出 compose、component 与 composition。

items.example: The lab stores many compounds.
items.exampleCN: 实验室储存许多化合物。

items.example: The error compounded the loss.
items.exampleCN: 这个错误加重了损失。

items.meaning: the act of adding or mixing
items.example: Compounding the mixture takes an hour.
items.exampleCN: 配制这种混合物要一小时。

items.example: The compounder weighed each powder.
items.exampleCN: 配制者称量了每种粉末。

items.example: These two elements are compoundable.
items.exampleCN: 这两种元素可以化合。

items.example: Six rooms compose the flat.
items.exampleCN: 六个房间组成这套公寓。

items.example: The composition of the alloy is secret.
items.exampleCN: 这种合金的成分是保密的。

items.example: The door is made of composite wood.
items.exampleCN: 这扇门由复合木材制成。

definition_zh: 理解；理解力；领悟；阅读理解练习
definition_en: the ability to understand something, or the act of understanding it
core_image: 一段外文读到最后，脑中忽然亮起整幅画面
scene: 老师让学生读完后用自己的话说出大意。The test measures reading comprehension, not memory.
sceneCN: 这里 comprehension 指「理解」（第 1 个义项：读懂意思的过程）；句意是这项测试考的是阅读理解，而不是记忆力。

pos.zh: 理解；理解力；阅读理解练习

senses.title: The act of understanding
senses.definition: the act of understanding the meaning of something
senses.definitionCN: 理解某事物含义的过程
senses.example: The poem is beyond my comprehension.
senses.exampleCN: 这首诗超出了我的理解。
senses.why: Meaning is not heard or seen; it is grasped inside the mind.
senses.whyCN: 意思不是听到或看到的，而是在脑中 grasp 到的。

senses.title: The ability to understand
senses.definition: the ability to understand something
senses.definitionCN: 理解某事物的能力
senses.example: His comprehension of the rules improved quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 他对规则的理解力提高得很快。
senses.why: Some minds take hold of an idea faster than others, and we name that power.
senses.whyCN: 有些头脑抓住一个想法更快，我们就给这种能力命名。

senses.title: A test of understanding
senses.definition: a test that measures how well you understand a text
senses.definitionCN: 衡量你对一段文字理解程度的测试
senses.example: She scored full marks on the comprehension.
senses.exampleCN: 她在阅读理解练习中得了满分。
senses.why: Schools turned the ability into a task with questions and marks.
senses.whyCN: 学校把这种能力变成带问题和分数的任务。

intro.en: Comprehension comes from Latin comprehendere, to seize or grasp, and first named the act of taking an idea into the mind.
intro.cn: comprehension 来自拉丁语 comprehendere（抓住、握住），最初指把想法收入脑中的动作。

items.en: Com- meant together and prehendere meant to seize.
items.cn: com- 表示一起，prehendere 表示抓住。

items.en: Comprehendere described seizing something with the hand or the mind.
items.cn: comprehendere 描述用手或用心智抓住某物。

items.en: Comprehensio named a complete grasp of a subject.
items.cn: comprehensio 指对某个主题的完整把握。

items.en: Old French comprehension kept the sense of full understanding.
items.cn: 古法语 comprehension 保留了完整理解的意思。

items.en: English comprehension first meant the act of grasping meaning.
items.cn: 英语 comprehension 最初指把握含义的行为。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that share the Latin root of comprehension, and the meaning group names other words for understanding.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 comprehension 同根同形的词，近义组列出其他表示理解的词。

entries.definition: including everything that is needed
to understand something fully
easy to understand
the knowledge of how something works
a full understanding of a subject
the way you notice or understand something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a hand closing on an object, then move to the mind closing on an idea.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一只手合拢抓住东西开始，再走到心智抓住一个想法。

normal.en: Com- is together and prehend is to seize, so comprehension is the mind seizing meaning.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，prehend 是抓住，comprehension 就是心智抓住意思。

normal.en: A text you comprehend stops being a wall of marks and becomes a picture.
normal.cn: 一段你读懂的文字，会从一堵符号墙变成一幅画。

normal.en: Comprehension is the noun, comprehend is the verb, comprehensible is the adjective.
normal.cn: comprehension 是名词，comprehend 是动词，comprehensible 是形容词。

normal.en: Beyond comprehension means the hand of the mind cannot close on it.
normal.cn: beyond comprehension 意味着心智之手合不拢它。

normal.en: A comprehension test only asks whether the picture formed.
normal.cn: 阅读理解测试只问那幅画面有没有形成。

abstract.en: Picture a fist slowly closing around a small bright object.
abstract.cn: 想象一只拳头慢慢合拢，包住一个发亮的小东西。

abstract.en: Picture fog clearing to reveal a whole valley.
abstract.cn: 想象雾气散开，露出整片山谷。

abstract.en: Picture puzzle pieces clicking into one picture.
abstract.cn: 想象拼图一块块咔哒合拢成一幅画。

examples.en: The instructions are simple and within most readers' comprehension.
examples.cn: 这些说明很简单，在多数读者的理解范围之内。

examples.en: Reading aloud can improve a child's comprehension.
examples.cn: 大声朗读能提高孩子的理解力。

examples.en: He answered every comprehension question correctly.
examples.cn: 他答对了每一道阅读理解题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 comprehension 记成 com（一起）加 prehend（抓住）：把意思整个抓住，就是理解。

root: 源自拉丁语 comprehendere（com 一起 + prehendere 抓住），本义是抓住、握住，后指心智把握含义，即理解与理解力。

sensesIntro.en: From the act of grasping meaning, to the power to grasp it, and finally to the school test built on that power.
sensesIntro.cn: 从抓住含义的动作，到抓住含义的能力，最后到以这种能力为基础的学校测试。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand closing around an object, just as the mind closes around an idea.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手合拢包住东西，正如心智合拢包住一个想法。

branches.en: Understanding as an act is the oldest and most direct sense.
branches.cn: 作为动作的理解，是最古老也最直接的义项。

branches.en: The same act, seen as a lasting power, becomes an ability.
branches.cn: 同一个动作若看作持久的能力，就成了理解力。

branches.en: Schools turned the ability into a paper task.
branches.cn: 学校把这种能力变成纸面上的任务。

branches.en: Act and ability differ only in whether they happen once or often.
branches.cn: 动作与能力只差在发生一次还是经常发生。

branches.en: A test exists only because the ability can be measured.
branches.cn: 测试之所以存在，正因为这种能力可以被衡量。

intro.en: Comprehension is built on Latin com-, together, plus prehendere, to seize, with the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: comprehension 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、prehendere（抓住）与名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base prehend- also gives apprehend and prehensile.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 prehend- 还给出 apprehend 与 prehensile。

items.example: Her comprehension of the text was exact.
items.exampleCN: 她对这篇文字的理解很准确。

items.example: I cannot comprehend such cruelty.
items.exampleCN: 我无法理解这样的残忍。

items.example: The guide is clear and comprehensible.
items.exampleCN: 这份指南清楚易懂。

items.example: They tested the comprehensibility of the form.
items.exampleCN: 他们测试了这张表格的可理解性。

items.meaning: in a way that can be understood
items.example: He explained the rule comprehensibly.
items.exampleCN: 他把规则解释得很清楚。

items.example: The library has a comprehensive index.
items.exampleCN: 这家图书馆有全面的索引。

items.example: The report covers the issue comprehensively.
items.exampleCN: 这份报告全面地涵盖了该问题。

items.example: The message was incomprehensible.
items.exampleCN: 这条消息令人无法理解。

definition_zh: 全面的；综合的；广泛的；综合中学
definition_en: including everything that is needed or relevant
core_image: 一张摊满整张桌面的大地图，把每条小路都画上
scene: 报告把每个环节都列了进去，一页也没漏。The report gives a comprehensive review of the whole project.
sceneCN: 这里 comprehensive 指「全面的」（第 1 个义项：涵盖所有部分）；句意是这份报告对整个项目做了全面回顾。

senses.title: Covering every part
senses.definition: including all or nearly all the parts of something
senses.definitionCN: 包含某事物的全部或几乎全部部分
senses.example: The book offers a comprehensive guide to the city.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书提供了一份全面的城市指南。
senses.why: A guide is called comprehensive when nothing important has been left out.
senses.whyCN: 当重要内容一样也没漏时，指南才被称为全面的。

senses.title: Wide in scope
senses.definition: broad enough to include many different things
senses.definitionCN: 范围足够广，能包含许多不同事物
senses.example: The law had a comprehensive effect on trade.
senses.exampleCN: 这项法律对贸易产生了广泛影响。
senses.why: Scope is breadth rather than depth, and comprehensive words stretch wide.
senses.whyCN: 范围讲的是广度而非深度，comprehensive 正是向四周铺开。

senses.title: A school for all abilities
senses.definition: in Britain, a secondary school for pupils of all abilities
senses.definitionCN: 在英国，招收各种能力学生的中学
senses.example: She went to the local comprehensive.
senses.exampleCN: 她上了当地的综合中学。
senses.why: The school takes in every kind of pupil, so it is comprehensive in people too.
senses.whyCN: 这所学校接纳各种学生，所以在人的意义上也是全面的。

intro.en: Comprehensive comes from Latin comprehendere, to seize or grasp, and first meant having the power to grasp everything.
intro.cn: comprehensive 来自拉丁语 comprehendere（抓住），最初指有能力把一切都抓住。

items.en: Comprehendere meant to seize or to take in completely.
items.cn: comprehendere 意为抓住或完整地纳入。

items.en: Comprehensivus described something that could take in all.
items.cn: comprehensivus 描述能纳入一切的东西。

items.en: French compréhensif kept the idea of wide grasp.
items.cn: 法语 compréhensif 保留了广泛把握的意思。

items.en: English comprehensive first meant including much in a small space.
items.cn: 英语 comprehensive 最初指在小篇幅内包含很多内容。

items.en: It grew to describe reports, insurance and schools.
items.cn: 后来它扩展到描述报告、保险与学校。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words sharing the shape of comprehensive, and the meaning group names other words for covering a whole.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 comprehensive 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示覆盖整体的词。

entries.definition: easy to understand
the ability to understand
in a complete and thorough way
having every necessary part
done with great care and in full
wide in range and effect

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a map that fills the whole table, then move to reports and to a school open to all.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一张铺满整桌的地图开始，再走到报告与向所有人开放的学校。

normal.en: Comprehend is to grasp, so comprehensive means able to grasp everything.
normal.cn: comprehend 是抓住，所以 comprehensive 就是能把一切抓住。

normal.en: A comprehensive review checks every room, not just the hall.
normal.cn: 全面的回顾会检查每个房间，而不只是大厅。

normal.en: Comprehensive insurance covers many kinds of damage at once.
normal.cn: 综合保险一次覆盖许多种损失。

normal.en: A comprehensive school takes pupils of every ability.
normal.cn: 综合中学招收各种能力的学生。

normal.en: Comprehensive and comprehensible differ: one covers all, one is easy to grasp.
normal.cn: comprehensive 与 comprehensible 不同：一个覆盖全部，一个容易理解。

abstract.en: Picture a map so large that no road is missing.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图大得没有一条路被漏掉。

abstract.en: Picture a checklist with every box already ticked.
abstract.cn: 想象一张清单，每个格子都已打勾。

abstract.en: Picture one net thrown over an entire field.
abstract.cn: 想象一张网罩住整片田野。

examples.en: The committee ordered a comprehensive review of the budget.
examples.cn: 委员会要求对预算进行全面审查。

examples.en: This dictionary aims to be comprehensive.
examples.cn: 这部词典力求全面。

examples.en: He attended a comprehensive in the north of the city.
examples.cn: 他在城北的一所综合中学就读。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 comprehensive 记成 com（一起）加 prehend（抓住）：把所有部分一起抓住，就是全面的。

root: 源自拉丁语 comprehendere（com 一起 + prehendere 抓住），本义是全部抓住，后引申为全面的、广泛的，并指招收各类学生的综合中学。

sensesIntro.en: From all parts of a thing, to a wide reach, and finally to a school that takes in every kind of pupil.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一件事的所有部分，到宽广的范围，最后到接纳各类学生的学校。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a map spread over the whole table, with every small road drawn in.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张铺满整桌的地图，连每条小路都画上了。

branches.en: Completeness of parts is the central sense.
branches.cn: 部分的完整是核心义项。

branches.en: Width of range is completeness stretched sideways.
branches.cn: 范围的宽广，是完整性向两侧铺开。

branches.en: A school becomes comprehensive by including all pupils.
branches.cn: 学校因接纳所有学生而变得 comprehensive。

branches.en: Both senses answer the question of what has been left out.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在回答漏掉了什么。

branches.en: A full report and a full school both refuse to exclude.
branches.cn: 完整的报告与完整的学校都拒绝排除。

intro.en: Comprehensive is built on Latin com-, together, plus prehendere, to seize, with the adjective ending -ive.
intro.cn: comprehensive 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、prehendere（抓住）与形容词词尾 -ive 构成。

latinIntro.en: The same base gives comprehension, comprehend and comprehensible.
latinIntro.cn: 同一个词基还给出 comprehension、comprehend 与 comprehensible。

items.example: They wrote a comprehensive plan.
items.exampleCN: 他们写了一份全面的计划。

items.example: The team reviewed the data comprehensively.
items.exampleCN: 团队全面地审查了数据。

items.example: The comprehensiveness of the index impressed us.
items.exampleCN: 索引的全面性让我们印象深刻。

items.example: Few could comprehend the scale of the loss.
items.exampleCN: 很少有人能理解损失之大。

items.example: Comprehension comes before memory.
items.exampleCN: 理解先于记忆。

items.example: Her answer was short and comprehensible.
items.exampleCN: 她的回答简短而清楚。

items.example: The noise was incomprehensible.
items.exampleCN: 那声音无法理解。

items.example: Editors check the comprehensibility of each page.
items.exampleCN: 编辑检查每一页的可理解性。

definition_zh: 压缩；压紧；简缩；敷布
definition_en: to press something into a smaller space, or to make speech or writing shorter
core_image: 双手把一团棉花使劲压成硬硬的一小块
scene: 打包行李时，她把毛衣卷紧塞进箱角。She managed to compress the sleeping bag into a small sack.
sceneCN: 这里 compress 指「压缩」（第 1 个义项：把东西压进更小的空间）；句意是她设法把睡袋压进一个小袋子里。

senses.title: Press into less space
senses.definition: to press something so that it takes up less space
senses.definitionCN: 按压某物，使它占据更小的空间
senses.example: The machine compresses the wool into bales.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器把羊毛压成捆。
senses.why: Force closes the gaps between fibres, and the same mass fits a smaller box.
senses.whyCN: 力量挤掉纤维间的空隙，同样的质量就装进更小的箱子。

senses.title: Make shorter
senses.definition: to make speech or writing shorter while keeping the main points
senses.definitionCN: 在保留要点的前提下使讲话或文字更短
senses.example: He compressed the report into two pages.
senses.exampleCN: 他把报告压缩成了两页。
senses.why: Words, like wool, carry empty space that can be pressed out.
senses.whyCN: 文字和羊毛一样带着可被挤掉的空间。

senses.title: A cloth pressed on the body
senses.definition: a cloth pressed against part of the body to reduce heat or stop bleeding
senses.definitionCN: 压在身体某部位以降热或止血的布
senses.example: Apply a cold compress to the bruise.
senses.exampleCN: 在淤伤处敷一块冷布。
senses.why: The cloth is literally pressed down, so the noun keeps the same picture.
senses.whyCN: 这块布确实被压下去，所以名词保留了同一幅画面。

intro.en: Compress comes from Latin comprimere, to press together, and first described physical squeezing.
intro.cn: compress 来自拉丁语 comprimere（压在一起），最初描述物理上的挤压。

items.en: Com- meant together and premere meant to press.
items.cn: com- 表示一起，premere 表示压。

items.en: Comprimere described pressing something into a tight mass.
items.cn: comprimere 描述把某物压成紧密的一团。

items.en: Old French compresser kept the physical sense of squeezing.
items.cn: 古法语 compresser 保留了挤压的具体含义。

items.en: English compress first meant to squeeze or to press down.
items.cn: 英语 compress 最初指挤压或按压。

items.en: It now also covers shortening text and shrinking computer files.
items.cn: 如今它也指缩短文字与缩小电脑文件。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words sharing the shape of compress, and the meaning group names other ways of making something smaller.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 compress 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他使东西变小的说法。

entries.definition: the act of pressing something smaller
a machine that compresses air or gas
to stop something by force
to press something firmly from both sides
to make something shorter or thicker
to make something less long

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with wool forced into a bale, then move to shortened reports and to a cold cloth.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被压成捆的羊毛开始，再走到缩短的报告与一块冷布。

normal.en: Com- is together and press is to squeeze, so compress is to squeeze together.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，press 是挤，compress 就是挤到一起。

normal.en: A compressed file takes less room on a disk.
normal.cn: 压缩过的文件在磁盘上占的地方更小。

normal.en: A cold compress is a cloth that presses down on a bruise.
normal.cn: 冷敷布就是压在淤伤上的一块布。

normal.en: Compress a long story and only the bones remain.
normal.cn: 把长故事压缩后，只剩下了骨架。

normal.en: The opposite is decompress, to let the air back in.
normal.cn: 反义词是 decompress，也就是让空气重新进去。

abstract.en: Picture a thick blanket rolled tight enough to tie.
abstract.cn: 想象一床厚毯子被卷紧到可以捆起来。

abstract.en: Picture a page of notes folded into a pocket.
abstract.cn: 想象一页笔记被折进衣袋。

abstract.en: Picture two hands pushing a spring flat.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手把一根弹簧压平。

examples.en: The pump compresses air into the tank.
examples.cn: 泵把空气压进罐里。

examples.en: She compressed her notes into a single page.
examples.cn: 她把笔记压缩成了一页。

examples.en: Hold the compress against the wound for five minutes.
examples.cn: 把敷布按在伤口上五分钟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 compress 记成 com（一起）加 press（压）：把东西压到一起，就是压缩。

root: 源自拉丁语 comprimere（com 一起 + premere 压），本义是压紧、挤压，后引申为简缩文字与压缩文件，并作名词指敷布。

sensesIntro.en: From wool pressed into a bale, to words pressed into a page, and finally to a cloth pressed on the skin.
sensesIntro.cn: 从羊毛被压成捆，到文字被压成一页，最后到压在皮肤上的布。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands forcing a ball of cotton into a hard little lump.
core.cn: 核心意象：双手把一团棉花压成硬硬的一小块。

branches.en: Physical squeezing is the oldest and clearest sense.
branches.cn: 物理挤压是最古老也最清楚的义项。

branches.en: Shortening text is squeezing words instead of wool.
branches.cn: 缩短文字，挤的是词而不是羊毛。

branches.en: The medical noun keeps the literal picture of a cloth pressed down.
branches.cn: 医学名词保留了布被压下去的字面画面。

branches.en: Both senses remove empty space and keep the substance.
branches.cn: 两个义项都去掉空隙，留下实质。

branches.en: A machine and a nurse both apply steady pressure.
branches.cn: 机器和护士都在施加稳定的压力。

intro.en: Compress is built on Latin com-, together, plus premere, to press.
intro.cn: compress 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 premere（压）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin press base also gives pressure, express and impress.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的压力词基还给出 pressure、express 与 impress。

items.example: The device compresses the gas quickly.
items.exampleCN: 这个装置迅速压缩气体。

items.example: The file is compressed for sending.
items.exampleCN: 文件已被压缩以便发送。

items.example: Compressing the soil damages roots.
items.exampleCN: 压紧土壤会伤到根。

items.meaning: the act or result of pressing
items.example: The compression of the spring stores energy.
items.exampleCN: 弹簧的压缩储存了能量。

items.example: The compressor is too loud.
items.exampleCN: 压缩机太吵了。

items.example: Air is highly compressible.
items.exampleCN: 空气很易压缩。

items.example: The material has high compressive strength.
items.exampleCN: 这种材料抗压强度高。

items.example: Divers must decompress slowly.
items.exampleCN: 潜水员必须缓慢减压。

items.example: Decompression takes several hours.
items.exampleCN: 减压需要好几个小时。

definition_zh: 包括；由…组成；构成
definition_en: to consist of particular parts, or to form a particular whole
core_image: 一只篮子里装着七种不同的水果，篮子本身不算在内
scene: 这支队伍由五名老队员和三名新人组成。The team comprises five veterans and three newcomers.
sceneCN: 这里 comprise 指「由…组成」（第 1 个义项：整体包含所列的部分）；句意是这支队伍由五名老队员和三名新人组成。

senses.title: Consist of parts
senses.definition: to be made up of the parts that are mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 由所提到的部分构成
senses.example: The course comprises six modules.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程由六个模块组成。
senses.why: The whole stands first, and the parts are listed as its contents.
senses.whyCN: 整体先站在那里，部分则作为它的内容被列出。

senses.title: Form a whole together
senses.definition: to combine to form a particular whole
senses.definitionCN: 结合起来构成某个整体
senses.example: These six states comprise the region.
senses.exampleCN: 这六个州构成这个地区。
senses.why: Look from the other side and the parts are the builders of the whole.
senses.whyCN: 从另一面看，部分就是整体的建造者。

intro.en: Comprise comes from French comprendre, to include, and its past participle compris, meaning included.
intro.cn: comprise 来自法语 comprendre（包括），其过去分词 compris 意为被包括在内。

items.en: Comprehendere meant to seize or to take in.
items.cn: comprehendere 意为抓住或纳入。

items.en: Old French comprendre meant to contain or to include.
items.cn: 古法语 comprendre 意为包含或包括。

items.en: The past participle compris meant included in a whole.
items.cn: 过去分词 compris 意为被包括在整体中。

items.en: English comprise first meant to lay hold of or to include.
items.cn: 英语 comprise 最初指握住或包括。

items.en: It settled into the two opposite-looking patterns of whole and parts.
items.cn: 它最终固定为整体与部分两种看似相反的用法。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to comprise, and the meaning group names other words for containing parts.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 comprise 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示包含部分的词。

entries.definition: to form a whole from parts
an agreement in which each side gives up something
an unexpected event or feeling
to have something as one of its parts
to have something inside
to include something as part of a whole

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a basket full of fruit, then look at the same basket from the fruit's side.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从装满水果的篮子开始，再从水果那一侧看同一只篮子。

normal.en: Com- is together and prise comes from prendre, to take, so comprise is to take things together.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，prise 源自 prendre（拿取），comprise 就是把东西一起收进来。

normal.en: A team comprises its members; the members compose the team.
normal.cn: 队伍 comprise 队员，而队员 compose 队伍。

normal.en: Do not say is comprised by; use is composed of instead.
normal.cn: 不要说 is comprised by，而用 is composed of 更稳妥。

normal.en: The whole comprises the parts, never the other way round.
normal.cn: 整体 comprise 部分，而不是反过来。

normal.en: A region comprises its states, and the states make up the region.
normal.cn: 地区 comprise 各州，而各州构成了地区。

abstract.en: Picture a basket holding seven different fruits.
abstract.cn: 想象一只篮子装着七种不同的水果。

abstract.en: Picture a single box with every item listed on its side.
abstract.cn: 想象一只箱子，侧面列着里面每样东西。

abstract.en: Picture a circle drawn around several separate dots.
abstract.cn: 想象一个圆圈把几个分开的点圈在一起。

examples.en: The committee comprises twelve members.
examples.cn: 委员会由十二名成员组成。

examples.en: These four counties comprise the whole province.
examples.cn: 这四个县构成整个省。

examples.en: The price comprises room and breakfast.
examples.cn: 价格包括房费和早餐。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 comprise 记成 com（一起）加 prise（拿取）：把一个整体里的部分一起拿进来，就是包括、由…组成。

root: 源自拉丁语 comprehendere（抓住、纳入）经法语 comprendre 与过去分词 compris 进入英语，本义是把部分收进整体，后指由…组成与构成。

sensesIntro.en: From a whole taking in its parts, to the parts building that whole.
sensesIntro.cn: 从整体把部分收进来，到部分建成那个整体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one basket holding seven kinds of fruit, with the basket itself not counted.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只篮子装着七种水果，篮子本身不计在内。

branches.en: The whole containing its parts is the usual modern sense.
branches.cn: 整体包含部分，是常见的现代义项。

branches.en: The parts forming the whole is the same fact seen from below.
branches.cn: 部分构成整体，是从下往上看同一件事。

branches.en: A course or a team is described from the whole side.
branches.cn: 课程或队伍通常从整体这一侧描述。

branches.en: A group of states is described from the parts side.
branches.cn: 一组州则从部分这一侧描述。

branches.en: Both patterns describe one relation of container and contents.
branches.cn: 两种句式描述的都是容器与内容的关系。

intro.en: Comprise is built on Latin com-, together, plus prehendere, to take, through the French past participle compris.
intro.cn: comprise 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 prehendere（拿取）构成，经法语过去分词 compris 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base prehend- also gives comprehend and comprehensive.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 prehend- 还给出 comprehend 与 comprehensive。

items.example: The set comprises four volumes.
items.exampleCN: 这套书由四卷组成。

items.example: The group is comprised of ten firms.
items.exampleCN: 这个集团由十家公司组成。

items.example: A panel comprising five judges will decide.
items.exampleCN: 一个由五名评委组成的小组将作出裁定。

items.example: The comprisal of all costs took time.
items.exampleCN: 把所有费用都包括进去花了些时间。

items.meaning: the way parts form a whole
items.example: The composition of the panel changed.
items.exampleCN: 小组的构成变了。

items.meaning: to form a whole from parts
items.example: Eight members compose the board.
items.exampleCN: 八名成员组成董事会。

items.example: The panel is a composite structure.
items.exampleCN: 这块板是复合结构。

items.example: A comprehensive list would be long.
items.exampleCN: 一份全面的清单会很长。

definition_zh: 妥协；折中；妥协方案；危及
definition_en: an agreement in which each side accepts less than it wanted
core_image: 两个人各退半步，在中间那条线上握手
scene: 谈价谈到天黑，买卖双方各让一步才成交。After hours of argument, they reached a compromise.
sceneCN: 这里 compromise 指「妥协方案」（第 1 个义项：双方各让一步达成的安排）；句意是争论几个小时后，他们达成了一个折中方案。

senses.title: A deal with give and take
senses.definition: an arrangement in which both sides give up part of what they want
senses.definitionCN: 双方都放弃部分要求的安排
senses.example: Both sides accepted a compromise on price.
senses.exampleCN: 双方接受了价格上的折中方案。
senses.why: Two wishes cannot both be fully met, so each side bends a little.
senses.whyCN: 两个愿望无法都完全满足，于是各自弯一点。

senses.title: Settle by giving way
senses.definition: to end an argument by each side giving up something
senses.definitionCN: 通过各方放弃一些东西来结束争论
senses.example: They compromised and shared the cost.
senses.exampleCN: 他们各让一步，分摊了费用。
senses.why: The verb names the act that produces the noun.
senses.whyCN: 动词命名的是产生这个名词的动作。

senses.title: Put something at risk
senses.definition: to weaken or damage something such as safety or quality
senses.definitionCN: 削弱或损害安全、质量等东西
senses.example: Never compromise on safety.
senses.exampleCN: 在安全上绝不能让步。
senses.why: If you give away a principle, you also put what depends on it in danger.
senses.whyCN: 让掉一条原则，依赖它的东西也就陷入危险。

intro.en: Compromise comes from Latin compromittere, to promise together, and named an agreement to accept an arbiter's decision.
intro.cn: compromise 来自拉丁语 compromittere（共同承诺），最初指共同接受仲裁者裁断的约定。

items.en: Com- meant together and promittere meant to promise.
items.cn: com- 表示一起，promittere 表示承诺。

items.en: Compromittere meant to bind both sides by a promise.
items.cn: compromittere 意为用承诺约束双方。

items.en: Old French compromis named the agreement itself.
items.cn: 古法语 compromis 指这份约定本身。

items.en: English compromise first meant a joint promise to accept a ruling.
items.cn: 英语 compromise 最初指共同承诺接受裁断。

items.en: It widened to any deal in which both sides give way.
items.cn: 后来它扩展到任何双方让步的交易。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to compromise, and the meaning group names other words for settling a dispute.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 compromise 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示了结争执的词。

entries.definition: to consist of particular parts
a statement that you will do something
a calm state of mind
an arrangement accepted by both sides
something given up to end an argument
an official end to a disagreement

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two people stepping toward the middle, then move to risk and to shared cost.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两个人向中间迈步开始，再走到风险与分摊费用。

normal.en: Com- is together and promise is a pledge, so a compromise is a pledge both sides keep.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，promise 是承诺，compromise 就是双方都守的承诺。

normal.en: Each side walks half the distance and meets in the middle.
normal.cn: 双方各走一半路，在中间相遇。

normal.en: A compromise is not a defeat; it is a shared saving of the deal.
normal.cn: 妥协不是失败，而是共同保住这笔交易。

normal.en: Compromise safety and the whole plan is at risk.
normal.cn: 危及安全，整个计划就都处在风险中。

normal.en: An uncompromising person refuses to move at all.
normal.cn: 一个 uncompromising 的人一步也不肯动。

abstract.en: Picture two hands meeting over the middle of a table.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在桌子中央上方握到一起。

abstract.en: Picture a rope pulled from both ends until each side shortens.
abstract.cn: 想象一根绳从两端被拉，直到两边都变短。

abstract.en: Picture a door neither side can close alone.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇任何一方都无法独自关上的门。

examples.en: The two leaders finally reached a compromise.
examples.cn: 两位领导人最终达成了妥协。

examples.en: She refused to compromise on the quality of the material.
examples.cn: 她拒绝在材料质量上让步。

examples.en: Cheap repairs may compromise the safety of the bridge.
examples.cn: 廉价维修可能危及这座桥的安全。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 compromise 记成 com（一起）加 promise（承诺）：双方一起许下各让一步的承诺，就是妥协。

root: 源自拉丁语 compromittere（com 一起 + promittere 承诺），本义是共同承诺接受裁断，后指双方各让一步达成的妥协，并引申为危及。

sensesIntro.en: From a joint promise to accept a ruling, to a deal with give and take, and finally to the risk of giving too much away.
sensesIntro.cn: 从共同承诺接受裁断，到各让一步的交易，最后到让得太多所带来的风险。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people each stepping half way and shaking hands on the middle line.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人各走半步，在中间那条线上握手。

branches.en: The noun names the agreement that ends the distance.
branches.cn: 名词指结束这段距离的那份约定。

branches.en: The verb names the act of stepping toward the middle.
branches.cn: 动词指向中间迈步的动作。

branches.en: Giving way on a principle creates a new kind of danger.
branches.cn: 在原则上让步，会产生一种新的危险。

branches.en: Deal and act are the same event seen as noun and verb.
branches.cn: 交易与动作是同一件事的名词与动词两面。

branches.en: Both involve giving something away, for peace or at a cost.
branches.cn: 两者都涉及让出东西，或为和平，或付出代价。

intro.en: Compromise is built on Latin com-, together, plus promittere, to promise, through the French form compromis.
intro.cn: compromise 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 promittere（承诺）构成，经法语 compromis 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin promise base also gives promise, promising and promissory.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的承诺词基还给出 promise、promising 与 promissory。

items.example: Small compromises kept the talks alive.
items.exampleCN: 一些小妥协让谈判得以继续。

items.example: The system was compromised by a virus.
items.exampleCN: 系统被病毒侵入而受损。

items.example: The photo was highly compromising.
items.exampleCN: 那张照片极有损声誉。

items.example: He was known as a practical compromiser.
items.exampleCN: 他以务实的妥协者著称。

items.example: The letters were compromisingly frank.
items.exampleCN: 这些信坦率得有损声誉。

items.example: She took an uncompromising stand.
items.exampleCN: 她采取了不妥协的立场。

items.example: He refused uncompromisingly.
items.exampleCN: 他毫不妥协地拒绝了。

items.example: She kept her promise to return.
items.exampleCN: 她遵守了回来的承诺。

definition_zh: 计算；估算；用计算机运算
definition_en: to calculate an amount or result using numbers or a computer
core_image: 手指在算盘上一颗颗拨珠，数字在脑中排成队
scene: 他用纸笔把每个月的开销一笔笔算出来。She computed the total cost before booking the tickets.
sceneCN: 这里 compute 指「计算」（第 1 个义项：用数字算出结果）；句意是她在订票前算出了总费用。

pos.zh: 计算；估算；用计算机运算

senses.title: Work out with numbers
senses.definition: to calculate an amount or result using numbers
senses.definitionCN: 用数字算出数量或结果
senses.example: He computed the distance in his head.
senses.exampleCN: 他在脑子里算出了距离。
senses.why: The oldest sense is counting and reckoning with figures.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是数数并用数字推算。

senses.title: Process data by machine
senses.definition: to use a computer to process data and produce results
senses.definitionCN: 用计算机处理数据并得出结果
senses.example: The program computes the results in seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 这个程序几秒钟就算出结果。
senses.why: A machine now does the old human work of reckoning, only faster.
senses.whyCN: 机器如今替人完成古老的推算工作，只是更快。

intro.en: Compute comes from Latin computare, to reckon together, built from com-, together, and putare, to count.
intro.cn: compute 来自拉丁语 computare（一起估算），由 com-（一起）与 putare（计数）构成。

items.en: Putare meant to count, to think over or to prune.
items.cn: putare 意为计数、思考或修剪。

items.en: Computare meant to add up and settle an account.
items.cn: computare 意为加总并结清账目。

items.en: Old French computer carried the word into bookkeeping.
items.cn: 古法语 computer 把这个词带入记账。

items.en: English compute meant to reckon or to estimate by figures.
items.cn: 英语 compute 意为用数字推算或估算。

items.en: The word gave birth to computer and to modern computing.
items.cn: 这个词后来衍生出 computer 与现代计算技术。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to compute, and the meaning group names other words for working out a figure.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 compute 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示算出数字的词。

entries.definition: to travel regularly to work
a machine that stores and processes data
the act of calculating
to work out a number using figures
to count or estimate something
to judge an amount roughly

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with beads on an abacus, then move to machines that reckon in seconds.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从算盘上的珠子开始，再走到几秒钟就能算完的机器。

normal.en: Com- is together and putare is to count, so compute is to count things together.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，putare 是计数，compute 就是把数字合起来算。

normal.en: A computer is simply a thing that computes.
normal.cn: computer 不过就是会 compute 的东西。

normal.en: Compute is the verb, computation is the noun, computer is the tool.
normal.cn: compute 是动词，computation 是名词，computer 是工具。

normal.en: You can compute in your head without any machine.
normal.cn: 不用任何机器，你也能在脑子里计算。

normal.en: The result is computed, not guessed.
normal.cn: 结果是算出来的，不是猜出来的。

abstract.en: Picture fingers moving beads along thin wires.
abstract.cn: 想象手指在细杆上拨动珠子。

abstract.en: Picture a column of figures adding into one line.
abstract.cn: 想象一列数字加总成一行。

abstract.en: Picture a small chip finishing a long sum instantly.
abstract.cn: 想象一块小芯片瞬间算完一长串加法。

examples.en: The software computes the average in a second.
examples.cn: 这个软件一秒钟就算出平均值。

examples.en: We computed the cost of the whole trip.
examples.cn: 我们算出了整趟旅行的费用。

examples.en: Early machines could compute only simple sums.
examples.cn: 早期的机器只能计算简单的加法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 compute 记成 com（一起）加 put（计算）：把数字合在一起算，就是计算。

root: 源自拉丁语 computare（com 一起 + putare 计数），本义是加总结账，后指一般意义上的计算与估算，并衍生出 computer 一词。

sensesIntro.en: From a person reckoning with figures, to a machine processing data in the same spirit.
sensesIntro.cn: 从人用数字推算，到机器以同样的精神处理数据。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fingers moving beads on an abacus while numbers line up in the mind.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指拨动算盘珠，数字在脑中排成队。

branches.en: Human reckoning is the ancient core of the word.
branches.cn: 人的推算是这个词古老的核心。

branches.en: The machine sense is the same act handed to silicon.
branches.cn: 机器义项只是把同一个动作交给芯片。

branches.en: Mental arithmetic needs no device at all.
branches.cn: 心算完全不需要任何设备。

branches.en: Modern computing extends the old verb to data of every kind.
branches.cn: 现代计算把这个古老动词扩展到各类数据。

branches.en: Both senses turn numbers into an answer.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把数字变成一个答案。

intro.en: Compute is built on Latin com-, together, plus putare, to count or reckon.
intro.cn: compute 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 putare（计数）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base put- also gives reputation, dispute and impute.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 put- 还给出 reputation、dispute 与 impute。

items.example: The app computes the shortest route.
items.exampleCN: 这个应用算出最短路线。

items.example: The computed value was correct.
items.exampleCN: 计算出的数值是对的。

items.example: Cloud computing changed the industry.
items.exampleCN: 云计算改变了这个行业。

items.example: The computer needs a new battery.
items.exampleCN: 这台电脑需要换电池。

items.example: The computation took two hours.
items.exampleCN: 这项运算花了两个小时。

items.example: They built a computational model.
items.exampleCN: 他们建立了一个计算模型。

items.example: The function is computable.
items.exampleCN: 这个函数是可计算的。

items.example: The first microcomputer appeared in the 1970s.
items.exampleCN: 第一台微型计算机出现在二十世纪七十年代。

definition_zh: 隐藏；隐瞒；掩盖
definition_en: to hide something or keep it secret
core_image: 一只手把一枚硬币悄悄塞到桌布下面
scene: 她把礼物藏在衣柜最上层，等生日那天再拿出来。He tried to conceal the gift behind the coats.
sceneCN: 这里 conceal 指「藏起」（第 1 个义项：放到看不见的地方）；句意是他想把礼物藏在大衣后面。

senses.title: Hide from sight
senses.definition: to put something where it cannot be seen
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放到看不见的地方
senses.example: The camera was concealed in a clock.
senses.exampleCN: 摄像头被藏在一只钟里。
senses.why: The word begins with physical hiding, a thing placed out of view.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指物理上的隐藏，把东西放到视线之外。

senses.title: Keep a fact secret
senses.definition: to keep information from other people
senses.definitionCN: 不让他人知道某些信息
senses.example: She concealed her disappointment.
senses.exampleCN: 她隐瞒了自己的失望。
senses.why: A feeling or fact can be hidden just as a box can be hidden.
senses.whyCN: 情绪或事实能像盒子一样被藏起来。

intro.en: Conceal comes from Latin concelare, to hide completely, built from com-, fully, and celare, to hide.
intro.cn: conceal 来自拉丁语 concelare（完全藏起），由 com-（完全）与 celare（隐藏）构成。

items.en: Celare meant to hide or to keep secret.
items.cn: celare 意为隐藏或保守秘密。

items.en: Concelare strengthened the verb into hiding completely.
items.cn: concelare 把动词强化为完全藏起来。

items.en: Old French concealer carried the strong sense of covering up.
items.cn: 古法语 concealer 保留了严密遮掩的强烈意味。

items.en: English conceal first meant to cover or to keep from sight.
items.cn: 英语 conceal 最初指遮盖或不让看见。

items.en: It now covers hiding facts, feelings and objects alike.
items.cn: 如今它同样覆盖隐藏事实、情绪与物件。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to conceal, and the meaning group names other words for keeping something out of view.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 conceal 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他把东西藏起来的词。

entries.definition: to admit that something is true
to decide that something will not happen
the act of hiding something
to put something where it cannot be seen
to put something over another thing
to hide a feeling or smell

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a coin slipping under a tablecloth, then move to secrets and to hidden feelings.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一枚硬币滑到桌布下开始，再走到秘密与被藏起的情绪。

normal.en: Con- makes the hiding complete, and celare is to hide, so conceal is to hide fully.
normal.cn: con- 让隐藏变得彻底，celare 是隐藏，所以 conceal 就是完全藏起来。

normal.en: A concealed camera is there but not seen.
normal.cn: 隐藏的摄像头在那里，却看不见。

normal.en: You can conceal a fact with silence as easily as with a lie.
normal.cn: 用沉默隐瞒事实，和用谎话一样容易。

normal.en: Conceal is more formal than hide, and often suggests intent.
normal.cn: conceal 比 hide 更正式，常暗示有意为之。

normal.en: The noun is concealment, the state of being kept from view.
normal.cn: 名词是 concealment，即被藏在视线之外的状态。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pushing a coin under a cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把硬币推到布下面。

abstract.en: Picture a smile that covers a whole bad day.
abstract.cn: 想象一个笑容盖住了整个糟糕的日子。

abstract.en: Picture a door painted the same colour as the wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门刷成和墙一样的颜色。

examples.en: He concealed the key under a loose stone.
examples.cn: 他把钥匙藏在一块松动的石头下。

examples.en: She could not conceal her surprise.
examples.cn: 她掩饰不住惊讶。

examples.en: The report concealed several important facts.
examples.cn: 这份报告隐瞒了几个重要事实。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conceal 记成 con（完全）加 ceal（藏）：把东西完全藏起来，就是隐藏、隐瞒。

root: 源自拉丁语 concelare（com 完全 + celare 隐藏），本义是完全藏起，后指隐藏物件与隐瞒事实、情绪。

sensesIntro.en: From an object put out of sight, to a fact kept from other people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被放到看不见处的物件，到不让他人知道的事实。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand sliding a coin under the tablecloth.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把硬币悄悄推到桌布下面。

branches.en: Physical hiding is the first and most literal sense.
branches.cn: 物理隐藏是第一个也最字面的义项。

branches.en: Information can be treated as an object placed out of view.
branches.cn: 信息可以被当作放到视线之外的物件。

branches.en: A concealed weapon is a legal and physical matter.
branches.cn: 隐藏的武器既涉及法律也涉及物理。

branches.en: A concealed feeling stays inside the person.
branches.cn: 被隐瞒的情绪留在人心里。

branches.en: Both senses depend on someone not seeing or not knowing.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖别人看不到或不知道。

intro.en: Conceal is built on Latin com-, fully, plus celare, to hide, through the French form concealer.
intro.cn: conceal 由拉丁语 com-（完全）与 celare（隐藏）构成，经法语 concealer 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin hide base cel- also survives in clandestine and cellar.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的隐藏词基 cel- 还留在 clandestine 与 cellar 中。

items.example: The wall conceals a small door.
items.exampleCN: 这堵墙后藏着一扇小门。

items.example: There was a concealed drawer in the desk.
items.exampleCN: 书桌里有一个暗抽屉。

items.example: He was accused of concealing evidence.
items.exampleCN: 他被指控隐瞒证据。

items.example: The money was kept in concealment.
items.exampleCN: 这笔钱被藏着。

items.example: She used concealer under her eyes.
items.exampleCN: 她在眼下用了遮瑕膏。

items.example: He spoke concealingly about the trip.
items.exampleCN: 他谈到那次旅行时遮遮掩掩。

items.example: The device is small and concealable.
items.exampleCN: 这个装置很小，便于隐藏。

items.example: His anger was unconcealed.
items.exampleCN: 他的怒气毫不掩饰。

definition_zh: 承认；让步；让出；失球
definition_en: to admit that something is true, or to allow someone to have something
core_image: 棋手把王轻轻推倒，抬手示意这一局认输
scene: 争论到最后，他点头承认对方说得有道理。He finally conceded that she had a point.
sceneCN: 这里 concede 指「承认」（第 1 个义项：不情愿地承认某事属实）；句意是他最后承认她说的有道理。

senses.title: Admit something is true
senses.definition: to admit that something is true, often unwillingly
senses.definitionCN: 常常不情愿地承认某事属实
senses.example: She conceded that the plan had failed.
senses.exampleCN: 她承认这个计划失败了。
senses.why: To concede is to stop resisting a fact you can no longer deny.
senses.whyCN: 承认就是停止抵抗一个再也无法否认的事实。

senses.title: Hand over a right
senses.definition: to allow someone to have something you held
senses.definitionCN: 允许别人得到你原本拥有的东西
senses.example: The company conceded two seats on the board.
senses.exampleCN: 公司让出了董事会的两个席位。
senses.why: The older sense is yielding ground, and ground can be a seat or a right.
senses.whyCN: 更古老的意思是让出地盘，而地盘也可以是席位或权利。

senses.title: Allow the other side to score
senses.definition: to allow the opposing team to score a goal or point
senses.definitionCN: 让对方球队攻入一球或得到一分
senses.example: The team conceded a goal in the last minute.
senses.exampleCN: 球队在最后一分钟失了一球。
senses.why: In sport you yield a point the way an army yields ground.
senses.whyCN: 在运动里让掉一分，就像军队让出阵地。

intro.en: Concede comes from Latin concedere, to go away or give way, built from com-, together, and cedere, to go.
intro.cn: concede 来自拉丁语 concedere（走开、让路），由 com-（一起）与 cedere（走）构成。

items.en: Cedere meant to go, to yield or to withdraw.
items.cn: cedere 意为走、让出或退去。

items.en: Concedere meant to give way or to grant a request.
items.cn: concedere 意为让路或应允请求。

items.en: French concéder kept the sense of granting and yielding.
items.cn: 法语 concéder 保留了应允与让出的意思。

items.en: English concede first meant to grant or to admit.
items.cn: 英语 concede 最初指准许或承认。

items.en: Sport added the sense of letting the other side score.
items.cn: 体育又加上了让对方得分的意思。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concede, and the meaning group names other words for admitting or yielding.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concede 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示承认与让出的词。

entries.definition: to form an idea in the mind
to hide something
to come before something else
to agree that something is true
to agree to give something
to give way under pressure

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a chess king tipped over, then move to yielding ground and to a lost goal.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被推倒的棋子王开始，再走到让出阵地与失球。

normal.en: Con- is together and cede is to go, so to concede is to go away from your own claim.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cede 是走，concede 就是从自己的主张上退开。

normal.en: To concede a point is to let the other side keep it.
normal.cn: 承认对方一点，就是让对方保住那一点。

normal.en: Concede and cede share the idea of giving ground.
normal.cn: concede 与 cede 都带有让出地盘的意思。

normal.en: A team that concedes a goal has allowed it, not scored it.
normal.cn: 球队 concede 一球，是让对方进球，不是自己进。

normal.en: Concession is the noun, the thing given away.
normal.cn: concession 是名词，即被让出去的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a chess player laying the king on its side.
abstract.cn: 想象棋手把王侧放在棋盘上。

abstract.en: Picture one side of a tug of war letting go of the rope.
abstract.cn: 想象拔河的一方松开绳子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand opening to release a held coin.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手摊开，放走握着的一枚硬币。

examples.en: He conceded that he had made a mistake.
examples.cn: 他承认自己犯了错。

examples.en: The government conceded several demands.
examples.cn: 政府让步，答应了若干要求。

examples.en: The team conceded twice in the second half.
examples.cn: 球队在下半场失了两球。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concede 记成 con（一起）加 cede（走）：从自己的立场上退开一步，就是让步、承认。

root: 源自拉丁语 concedere（com 一起 + cedere 走），本义是走开、让路，后引申为让出权利、承认事实与在比赛中失球。

sensesIntro.en: From stepping aside, to admitting a fact, and finally to letting the other side score.
sensesIntro.cn: 从让到一边，到承认一个事实，最后到让对方得分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chess player tipping the king over to end the game.
core.cn: 核心意象：棋手把王推倒，结束这一局。

branches.en: Admitting a fact is the most common modern sense.
branches.cn: 承认事实是最常见的现代义项。

branches.en: Giving up a right is the older, more physical sense.
branches.cn: 让出权利是更古老、更具体的义项。

branches.en: Sport borrows the same picture of yielding ground.
branches.cn: 体育借用了同一幅让出地盘的画面。

branches.en: Admitting and granting both lower your own claim.
branches.cn: 承认与给予都降低了自己的主张。

branches.en: A seat and a goal are both things you let go.
branches.cn: 席位和进球都是你放手让出的东西。

intro.en: Concede is built on Latin com-, together, plus cedere, to go or yield.
intro.cn: concede 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 cedere（走、让）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin go base ced- also gives proceed, recede and access.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的行走词基 ced- 还给出 proceed、recede 与 access。

items.example: He concedes that the evidence is strong.
items.exampleCN: 他承认证据很有力。

items.example: The seat was conceded without a fight.
items.exampleCN: 那个席位未经争夺就让出了。

items.example: She smiled without conceding anything.
items.exampleCN: 她笑了笑，却没有让出任何东西。

items.example: Each side made one concession.
items.exampleCN: 各方都作了一项让步。

items.example: The clause begins with a concessive word.
items.exampleCN: 这个从句以一个让步词开头。

items.example: They offered concessionary tickets.
items.exampleCN: 他们提供了优惠票。

items.example: He was the first conceder in the debate.
items.exampleCN: 他是辩论中第一个让步的人。

items.example: It is concededly a difficult task.
items.exampleCN: 这公认是件难事。

definition_zh: 集中；专心；聚集；浓缩物
definition_en: to give all your attention to one thing, or to make something stronger by removing water
core_image: 一束散开的光被透镜收成一个亮点
scene: 图书馆里，她把手机翻面扣在桌上才开始读书。He turned off the music so he could concentrate on the chapter.
sceneCN: 这里 concentrate 指「集中注意力」（第 1 个义项：把心思放在一件事上）；句意是他关掉音乐，好把注意力集中在这一章上。

senses.title: Focus your attention
senses.definition: to give all your attention to one thing
senses.definitionCN: 把全部注意力放在一件事上
senses.example: She concentrated on the map.
senses.exampleCN: 她专心看地图。
senses.why: The mind scatters easily, so it must be gathered onto one point.
senses.whyCN: 心思容易散开，所以必须收拢到一个点上。

senses.title: Bring together in one place
senses.definition: to bring things or people together in one place
senses.definitionCN: 把事物或人聚到一个地方
senses.example: The troops were concentrated near the border.
senses.exampleCN: 部队集中在边境附近。
senses.why: The same gathering motion works for armies and for attention.
senses.whyCN: 这种收拢的动作既能用于军队，也能用于注意力。

senses.title: Make stronger by removing water
senses.definition: to make a liquid stronger by taking water out of it
senses.definitionCN: 去掉水分使液体更浓
senses.example: The juice is concentrated before shipping.
senses.exampleCN: 果汁在运输前先被浓缩。
senses.why: Less water means the same substance sits in a smaller space.
senses.whyCN: 水分少了，同样的物质就集中在更小的空间里。

intro.en: Concentrate is built from Latin com-, together, and centrum, the centre: to bring to one centre.
intro.cn: concentrate 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 centrum（中心）构成，意为聚到一个中心。

items.en: Centrum meant the middle point of a circle.
items.cn: centrum 指圆的中心点。

items.en: Concentrare meant to bring several things to one centre.
items.cn: concentrare 意为把几样东西聚到一个中心。

items.en: French concentrer applied the word to liquids and to thought.
items.cn: 法语 concentrer 把它同时用于液体与思想。

items.en: English concentrate first meant to bring to a common centre.
items.cn: 英语 concentrate 最初指聚到共同的中心。

items.en: It now covers attention, troops and strong liquids.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖注意力、部队与浓液体。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concentrate, and the meaning group names other words for gathering or focusing.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concentrate 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示聚集与聚焦的词。

entries.definition: having the same centre
the ability to focus attention
strong because water has been removed
to give attention to one thing
to bring people or things together
to make something thicker or shorter

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with light through a lens, then move to troops in one place and to strong juice.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从穿过透镜的光开始，再走到聚集一处的部队与浓果汁。

normal.en: Con- is together and centre is the middle, so concentrate is to bring everything to the middle.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，centre 是中心，concentrate 就是把一切收拢到中心。

normal.en: A lens concentrates light into one bright point.
normal.cn: 透镜把光集中成一个亮点。

normal.en: Concentrate on one page and the other pages go quiet.
normal.cn: 专心看一页，其他页就安静下来。

normal.en: Concentrated juice has less water and more taste.
normal.cn: 浓缩果汁水分更少，味道更足。

normal.en: The noun concentration covers both attention and strength of a mixture.
normal.cn: 名词 concentration 同时覆盖注意力与混合物的浓度。

abstract.en: Picture a magnifying glass burning a small dot on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象放大镜在纸上烧出一个小点。

abstract.en: Picture many roads all ending at one square.
abstract.cn: 想象许多条路都通向同一个广场。

abstract.en: Picture a wide river squeezed into a narrow channel.
abstract.cn: 想象一条宽河被收进窄窄的河道。

examples.en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
examples.cn: 在吵闹的房间里很难集中注意力。

examples.en: The general concentrated his forces near the river.
examples.cn: 将军把兵力集中在河边。

examples.en: The factory concentrates the milk before packing it.
examples.cn: 工厂先把牛奶浓缩再包装。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concentrate 记成 con（一起）加 centre（中心）：把力气和心思一起收到中心，就是集中、专心。

root: 源自拉丁语 com（一起）与 centrum（中心），本义是聚到一个中心，后引申为集中注意力、聚集力量与浓缩液体。

sensesIntro.en: From many rays meeting at one point, to many people in one place, and finally to less water in the same liquid.
sensesIntro.cn: 从许多光线汇于一点，到许多人聚于一处，最后到同样液体里更少的水。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lens drawing scattered light into one bright point.
core.cn: 核心意象：透镜把散开的光收成一个亮点。

branches.en: Attention is the most common everyday sense.
branches.cn: 注意力是最常见的日常义项。

branches.en: Bringing people or troops together is the physical version.
branches.cn: 把人员或部队聚到一起是它的具体版本。

branches.en: Removing water concentrates a liquid in the same pattern.
branches.cn: 去掉水分以同样的方式浓缩液体。

branches.en: Mind and army both gain force by gathering.
branches.cn: 心思与军队都因收拢而增强力量。

branches.en: Both senses make one place or one liquid hold more.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让一个地方或一种液体装得更多。

intro.en: Concentrate is built on Latin com-, together, plus centrum, centre, with the verb ending -ate.
intro.cn: concentrate 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、centrum（中心）与动词词尾 -ate 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin centre base also gives central, eccentric and concentric.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的中心的词基还给出 central、eccentric 与 concentric。

items.example: The plant concentrates the ore first.
items.exampleCN: 工厂先把矿石富集。

items.example: The detergent is highly concentrated.
items.exampleCN: 这种洗涤剂浓度很高。

items.example: He sat concentrating on one page.
items.exampleCN: 他坐着专心看一页书。

items.example: The task demands full concentration.
items.exampleCN: 这项任务需要全神贯注。

items.example: The concentrator removes water from the juice.
items.exampleCN: 浓缩器把果汁里的水去掉。

items.example: The work has a concentrative effect.
items.exampleCN: 这项工作有让人专注的作用。

items.example: The rings are concentric.
items.exampleCN: 这些圆环是同心圆。

items.example: Try to concentrate on the first question.
items.exampleCN: 试着把注意力放在第一个问题上。

definition_zh: 专注；集中；浓度；聚集
definition_en: the ability to focus your attention, or the amount of a substance in a mixture
core_image: 一盏聚光灯把光全部打在一个点上
scene: 考场里安静得只剩笔尖划纸的声音。Total concentration is needed for this kind of puzzle.
sceneCN: 这里 concentration 指「专注」（第 1 个义项：把注意力完全放在一件事上）；句意是解这类谜题需要全神贯注。

senses.title: The power to focus
senses.definition: the ability to give all your attention to something
senses.definitionCN: 把全部注意力放在某事上的能力
senses.example: Reading in noise demands great concentration.
senses.exampleCN: 在噪声中阅读需要高度专注。
senses.why: The mind must hold one point and let the rest fade.
senses.whyCN: 心智必须守住一个点，让其余的都淡下去。

senses.title: A gathering in one place
senses.definition: the act of bringing many things together in one place
senses.definitionCN: 把许多东西聚到一处
senses.example: The concentration of factories in the valley worried residents.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂聚集在山谷里，让居民担忧。
senses.why: People and things can be gathered just as light is gathered.
senses.whyCN: 人和物都能像光一样被收拢。

senses.title: Strength of a mixture
senses.definition: the amount of a substance in a given amount of liquid or air
senses.definitionCN: 一定量液体或空气中所含某物质的量
senses.example: The concentration of salt in the water is low.
senses.exampleCN: 水中盐的浓度很低。
senses.why: How much is packed into a space is the scientific face of the same word.
senses.whyCN: 一个空间里装了多少，是这个词的科学一面。

intro.en: Concentration comes from Latin com-, together, and centrum, centre, through the verb concentrare.
intro.cn: concentration 来自拉丁语 com-（一起）与 centrum（中心），经动词 concentrare 演变而来。

items.en: Centrum named the middle point of a circle.
items.cn: centrum 指圆的中心点。

items.en: Concentrare meant to bring things to one centre.
items.cn: concentrare 意为把东西聚到一个中心。

items.en: French concentration named the act of gathering.
items.cn: 法语 concentration 指聚集的行为。

items.en: English concentration first meant the act of bringing to a centre.
items.cn: 英语 concentration 最初指聚到中心的行为。

items.en: Science gave it the sense of strength in a mixture.
items.cn: 科学又赋予它混合物中浓度的含义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concentration, and the meaning group names other words for attention and density.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concentration 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示注意力与密度的词。

entries.definition: to focus attention on one thing
having the same centre
giving attention to one thing
the centre of attention or interest
the act of watching or listening carefully
the amount of something in a space

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a spotlight on one point, then move to crowded places and to strong mixtures.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从打在一个点上的聚光灯开始，再走到拥挤的地方与浓的混合物。

normal.en: Concentration is what a spotlight does: one point, all the light.
normal.cn: concentration 就是聚光灯做的事：一个点，全部的光。

normal.en: The noun ends in -tion, so it names the state, not the act of trying.
normal.cn: 这个名词以 -tion 结尾，所以它命名的是状态，而不是尝试的动作。

normal.en: Lose concentration and the page turns back into marks.
normal.cn: 一走神，书页又变回一堆符号。

normal.en: A high concentration of salt means a lot of salt in little water.
normal.cn: 盐的浓度高，就是少量水里有很多盐。

normal.en: Factories in one valley show a concentration of industry.
normal.cn: 工厂聚在一个山谷，显示出产业的集中。

abstract.en: Picture a single lamp lighting one small circle in a dark room.
abstract.cn: 想象黑屋里一盏灯只照亮一个小圆圈。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd pressed into one narrow street.
abstract.cn: 想象人群挤进一条窄街。

abstract.en: Picture a spoon of syrup in a glass of water.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯水里的一勺糖浆。

examples.en: A good night's sleep improves concentration.
examples.cn: 睡个好觉能提高专注力。

examples.en: The concentration of birds near the lake is remarkable.
examples.cn: 湖边的鸟群聚集得十分可观。

examples.en: Scientists measured the concentration of oxygen in the air.
examples.cn: 科学家测量了空气中氧气的浓度。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concentration 记成 con（一起）加 centre（中心）加 ion：所有注意力收到一个中心，就是专注，也可指浓度。

root: 源自拉丁语 com（一起）与 centrum（中心），本义是聚向中心的行为与状态，后引申为专注、聚集与浓度。

sensesIntro.en: From a spotlight on one point, to a crowd in one street, and finally to much substance in little liquid.
sensesIntro.cn: 从打在一点上的聚光灯，到挤在一条街上的人群，最后到少量液体里的许多物质。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spotlight pouring all its light onto a single point.
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏聚光灯把光全部打在一个点上。

branches.en: Attention is the everyday sense most learners meet first.
branches.cn: 注意力是学习者最先遇到的日常义项。

branches.en: A crowd or a cluster of factories shows the gathering sense.
branches.cn: 人群或工厂群体现了聚集义项。

branches.en: Chemistry measures how much is packed into a space.
branches.cn: 化学衡量的是一个空间里装了多少。

branches.en: Mind and crowd both become stronger at one point.
branches.cn: 心思与人群都在一个点上变得更强。

branches.en: Gathering things and packing a liquid follow one pattern.
branches.cn: 聚拢东西与装浓液体遵循同一种模式。

intro.en: Concentration is built on Latin com-, together, plus centrum, centre, with the noun ending -ation.
intro.cn: concentration 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、centrum（中心）与名词词尾 -ation 构成。

latinIntro.en: The centre base centr- also gives central, eccentric and centrifugal.
latinIntro.cn: 中心词基 centr- 还给出 central、eccentric 与 centrifugal。

items.example: The samples showed different concentrations.
items.exampleCN: 样本显示出不同的浓度。

items.example: Please concentrate on the question.
items.exampleCN: 请把注意力放在问题上。

items.example: The syrup is very concentrated.
items.exampleCN: 这种糖浆很浓。

items.example: She sat concentrating for an hour.
items.exampleCN: 她坐着专注了一个小时。

items.example: Silence has a concentrative power.
items.exampleCN: 安静有让人专注的力量。

items.example: The concentrator runs all night.
items.exampleCN: 浓缩器整夜运转。

items.example: The target has concentric circles.
items.exampleCN: 靶子上有同心圆。

items.example: The older text uses concentrical rings.
items.exampleCN: 较早的文本用 concentrical 表示同心环。

definition_zh: 概念；观念；设想；构想
definition_en: an idea or a general notion of something
core_image: 空中飘着一条细细的线，把许多例子串成一个小结
scene: 老师用几个圆圈画出「公平」这个概念。The children drew pictures to show the concept of fairness.
sceneCN: 这里 concept 指「概念」（第 1 个义项：对事物的一般想法）；句意是孩子们用图画来表现公平这个概念。

senses.title: A general idea
senses.definition: an idea of what something is or how it works
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物是什么或如何运作的想法
senses.example: The concept of time varies across cultures.
senses.exampleCN: 时间的概念在不同文化中有所不同。
senses.why: A concept gathers many examples under one name in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 概念在脑中把许多例子收在同一个名字下。

senses.title: A plan or design
senses.definition: an idea for a new product, plan or work
senses.definitionCN: 对新产品、计划或作品的设想
senses.example: The concept car was shown at the fair.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆概念车在展会上亮相。
senses.why: Before a thing exists, it exists as a picture in someone's mind.
senses.whyCN: 在事物存在之前，它先作为脑海中的画面存在。

intro.en: Concept comes from Latin conceptum, a thing conceived, from concipere, to take in or to conceive.
intro.cn: concept 来自拉丁语 conceptum（被孕育之物），源自动词 concipere（纳入、孕育）。

items.en: Concipere joined com-, together, with capere, to take.
items.cn: concipere 由 com-（一起）与 capere（拿取）组合而成。

items.en: Conceptum named something taken into the mind.
items.cn: conceptum 指被收入心智的东西。

items.en: Conceptus described a thought formed inside a person.
items.cn: conceptus 描述在人内部形成的想法。

items.en: English concept named a general idea held in the mind.
items.cn: 英语 concept 指脑中持有的一般想法。

items.en: It now also names the first design of a product.
items.cn: 如今它也指产品最初的设想设计。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concept, and the meaning group names other words for an idea in the mind.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concept 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示脑中想法的词。

entries.definition: the forming of an idea in the mind
a paper showing that you have paid
too much pride in yourself
a thought or suggestion about something
a belief or idea, often vague
an idea used to explain something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with many examples tied into one knot, then move to a car that exists only as a drawing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从许多例子被系成一个结开始，再走到只以图纸存在的汽车。

normal.en: Con- is together and cept is to take, so a concept is what the mind takes in together.
