normal.cn: con- 是一起，cept 是拿取，concept 就是心智一起收进来的东西。

normal.en: A concept is a box in the mind that holds many examples.
normal.cn: 概念是脑中的一只盒子，装着许多例子。

normal.en: Concept is the thing; conception is the act of forming it.
normal.cn: concept 是那个东西，conception 是形成它的动作。

normal.en: A concept car is a car that lives in the mind before the road.
normal.cn: 概念车是先活在脑中、后上路的汽车。

normal.en: Abstract concepts have no shape, so we borrow pictures for them.
normal.cn: 抽象概念没有形状，所以我们借图画来表现它们。

abstract.en: Picture many scattered dots joined by one thin line.
abstract.cn: 想象许多散点被一条细线连起来。

abstract.en: Picture a light bulb above a sketched machine.
abstract.cn: 想象一台草图机器上方亮起一只灯泡。

abstract.en: Picture a label that fits a whole shelf of jars.
abstract.cn: 想象一张标签适合整架罐子。

examples.en: Children learn the concept of number before they write figures.
examples.cn: 孩子在写数字之前先学会数的概念。

examples.en: The designer explained her concept for the new library.
examples.cn: 设计师讲解了她对新图书馆的构想。

examples.en: It is a simple concept but hard to apply.
examples.cn: 这是个简单的概念，却很难应用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concept 记成 con（一起）加 cept（拿取）：把许多例子一起收进脑子，就成了一个概念。

root: 源自拉丁语 concipere（com 一起 + capere 拿取）的过去分词 conceptum，本义是收入心智之物，后指概念与构想。

sensesIntro.en: From a general idea that gathers examples, to a design that exists before the object.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把例子收拢起来的一般想法，到先于实物存在的设计。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one thin line tying many scattered examples into a single knot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条细线把许多散开的例子系成一个结。

branches.en: The general idea is the central and most common sense.
branches.cn: 一般想法是核心也最常见的义项。

branches.en: The design sense narrows the idea to a future product.
branches.cn: 设计义项把想法收窄到未来的产品。

branches.en: Philosophers study concepts as units of thought.
branches.cn: 哲学家把概念当作思维单位来研究。

branches.en: Companies show concept models before they sell anything.
branches.cn: 公司在销售之前先展示概念模型。

branches.en: Both senses are things held in the mind before they are things in the world.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是先存在于脑中、后存在于世上的东西。

intro.en: Concept is built on Latin com-, together, plus capere, to take, through the form conceptum.
intro.cn: concept 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 capere（拿取）构成，形式为 conceptum。

latinIntro.en: The Latin take base cap- also gives capture, accept and capacity.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的拿取词基 cap- 还给出 capture、accept 与 capacity。

items.example: The course introduces basic concepts.
items.exampleCN: 这门课介绍基本概念。

items.example: Her conception of duty is strict.
items.exampleCN: 她对责任的理解很严格。

items.example: The drawing is still conceptual.
items.exampleCN: 这张图仍停留在概念阶段。

items.example: The two plans are conceptually similar.
items.exampleCN: 这两个方案在概念上相似。

items.meaning: to form an idea of something
items.example: It is hard to conceptualize such a large number.
items.exampleCN: 很难构想这么大的数字。

items.example: The book offers a new conceptualization of space.
items.exampleCN: 这本书提供了对空间的新概念化。

items.example: He wrote about medieval conceptualism.
items.exampleCN: 他写过关于中世纪概念论的文章。

items.example: They misconceive the purpose of the rule.
items.exampleCN: 他们误解了这条规则的目的。

definition_zh: 担忧；关心；涉及；关系；公司
definition_en: a feeling of worry, or something that affects or involves you
core_image: 母亲站在校门口，目光一直追着孩子的背影
scene: 医生看着检查单，眉头慢慢皱了起来。The results concern me, so I want more tests.
sceneCN: 这里 concern 指「使担忧」（第 2 个义项：让人感到不安）；句意是这些结果让我担心，所以我想再做几项检查。

pos.zh: 担忧；关心；关切的事；公司

collocations.phrase: as far as I am concerned

senses.title: A feeling of worry
senses.definition: a feeling of worry about something important
senses.definitionCN: 对重要事物的担忧之情
senses.example: There is growing concern about air quality.
senses.exampleCN: 人们对空气质量的担忧与日俱增。
senses.why: When something matters, the mind keeps returning to it with unease.
senses.whyCN: 当某件事重要时，心就会带着不安一再回到它身上。

senses.title: To make someone worried
senses.definition: to make someone feel worried or anxious
senses.definitionCN: 使某人感到担心或不安
senses.example: The test results concern the doctor.
senses.exampleCN: 检查结果让医生担忧。
senses.why: A fact can reach out and trouble the person who learns it.
senses.whyCN: 一个事实能伸出去，扰动得知它的人。

senses.title: To be about or affect
senses.definition: to affect someone, or to be about a particular subject
senses.definitionCN: 影响某人，或关于某个主题
senses.example: This decision concerns every employee.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定涉及每一位员工。
senses.why: What touches you is what you must care about, so concern also means involvement.
senses.whyCN: 触动你的东西就是你必须在意的，所以 concern 也指关涉。

intro.en: Concern comes from Latin concernere, to sift together, from com-, together, and cernere, to sift or judge.
intro.cn: concern 来自拉丁语 concernere（一起筛），由 com-（一起）与 cernere（筛、判断）构成。

items.en: Cernere meant to sift, to separate or to judge.
items.cn: cernere 意为筛、分辨或判断。

items.en: Concernere meant to sift things together into one view.
items.cn: concernere 意为把东西筛到一起，纳入同一视野。

items.en: Old French concerner meant to relate to or to touch.
items.cn: 古法语 concerner 意为与…相关或触及。

items.en: English concern first meant to be relevant to something.
items.cn: 英语 concern 最初指与某事相关。

items.en: The sense of worry grew from things that are relevant and important.
items.cn: 担忧义从相关且重要的事情中生长出来。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concern, and the meaning group names other words for worry and involvement.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concern 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示担忧与关涉的词。

about a particular subject

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a parent watching a child, then move to a doctor reading results and to a rule that touches everyone.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从母亲望着孩子开始，再走到医生看检查单与涉及每个人的规定。

normal.en: Con- is together and cern is to sift, so concern is what your mind keeps sifting over.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cern 是筛，concern 就是心里反复筛检的那件事。

normal.en: Concern as a noun is the worry; concern as a verb is what causes it.
normal.cn: concern 作名词是担忧，作动词则是引起担忧的东西。

normal.en: As far as I am concerned means as far as this touches me.
normal.cn: 「as far as I am concerned」意为就触及我的范围而言。

normal.en: A going concern is a business that is still running.
normal.cn: a going concern 就是仍在运转的企业。

normal.en: Concerned parents ask questions; unconcerned ones do not.
normal.cn: 关心的父母会追问，漠不关心的则不会。

abstract.en: Picture a mother at the school gate watching one small back.
abstract.cn: 想象母亲在校门口望着一个小小的背影。

abstract.en: Picture a finger tracing a line of test results.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指沿着一行检查结果划过去。

abstract.en: Picture a circle drawn around everyone in a room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个圆圈把屋里每个人都圈了进去。

examples.en: There is real concern about the rising cost of housing.
examples.cn: 人们对住房成本上涨确有担忧。

examples.en: Her health concerns the whole family.
examples.cn: 她的健康让全家担忧。

examples.en: The new rules concern every member of staff.
examples.cn: 新规定涉及每一位员工。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concern 记成 con（一起）加 cern（筛）：心里反复筛来筛去的那件事，就是担忧与关切。

root: 源自拉丁语 concernere（com 一起 + cernere 筛、判断），本义是把事物筛到一起加以分辨，后引申为涉及、关心与担忧。

sensesIntro.en: From something sifted into your view, to the worry it causes, and finally to the fact that it affects you.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被筛进你视野的事，到它引起的担忧，最后到它确实影响到你。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mother at the school gate, her eyes following one small figure.
core.cn: 核心意象：母亲站在校门口，目光追着一个小小的身影。

branches.en: The noun sense of worry is the most common in daily speech.
branches.cn: 名词的担忧义是日常口语中最常见的。

branches.en: The verb can point at the cause of worry rather than the feeling.
branches.cn: 动词可以指向担忧的起因，而非感受本身。

branches.en: Involvement is the oldest layer, still visible in concerning.
branches.cn: 关涉是最古老的一层，仍留在 concerning 里。

branches.en: Feeling and cause are two ends of one relation.
branches.cn: 感受与起因是同一关系两端。

branches.en: What touches you can worry you, and what worries you clearly touches you.
branches.cn: 触及你的事可能让你担忧，让你担忧的事必然触及你。

intro.en: Concern is built on Latin com-, together, plus cernere, to sift, through the French form concerner.
intro.cn: concern 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 cernere（筛）构成，经法语 concerner 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin sift base cern- also gives discern, certain and discriminate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的筛分词基 cern- 还给出 discern、certain 与 discriminate。

items.example: Parents raised several concerns.
items.exampleCN: 家长提出了几项担忧。

items.example: The concerned neighbours called the police.
items.exampleCN: 担心的邻居报了警。

items.example: She asked a question concerning safety.
items.exampleCN: 她问了一个关于安全的问题。

items.example: He looked at the meter concernedly.
items.exampleCN: 他担忧地看着仪表。

items.example: She seemed unconcerned by the delay.
items.exampleCN: 她似乎对延误毫不在意。

items.example: His unconcern surprised everyone.
items.exampleCN: 他的漠不关心让大家吃惊。

items.example: The concernment of the issue is clear.
items.exampleCN: 这个问题的重要性很清楚。

items.example: The concert raised money for the school.

definition_zh: 音乐会；演奏会；一致；协作
definition_en: a public performance of music, or agreement between people acting together
core_image: 整个乐团在指挥抬手的一瞬同时吸气
scene: 大厅的灯暗下来，第一声小提琴响起。The concert began with a single note from the violin.
sceneCN: 这里 concert 指「音乐会」（第 1 个义项：公开的音乐演出）；句意是音乐会以小提琴的一个单音开始。

pos.zh: 音乐会；演奏会；一致；协作

senses.title: A music performance
senses.definition: a public performance of music given by one or more musicians
senses.definitionCN: 由一位或多位音乐家进行的公开音乐演出
senses.example: The concert lasted two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这场音乐会持续了两个小时。
senses.why: Many players must sound as one, so the event is named for their agreement.
senses.whyCN: 许多演奏者必须听起来像一个，所以这场活动以他们的和谐命名。

senses.title: Acting together
senses.definition: agreement or combined action between people or groups
senses.definitionCN: 人或团体之间的一致或联合行动
senses.example: The two groups acted in concert.
senses.exampleCN: 两个团体协同行动。
senses.why: The older sense is harmony, and harmony between people is also concert.
senses.whyCN: 更古老的意思是和谐，而人与人之间的和谐也是 concert。

intro.en: Concert comes from Italian concerto, agreement or harmony, and first named musicians playing as one.
intro.cn: concert 来自意大利语 concerto（一致、和谐），最初指乐手们如同一人地演奏。

items.en: Concertare meant to strive or to work together.
items.cn: concertare 意为共同努力或相互竞争。

items.en: Concerto named voices or instruments sounding in harmony.
items.cn: concerto 指人声或乐器和谐地响起。

items.en: A concerto also became a piece for soloist and orchestra.
items.cn: concerto 也成为一种独奏与乐队合作的作品。

items.en: French concert named a public musical gathering.
items.cn: 法语 concert 指公开的音乐聚会。

items.en: English concert took both the musical and the agreement senses.
items.cn: 英语 concert 同时接纳了音乐与一致两种含义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concert, and the meaning group names other words for a musical show.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concert 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示音乐演出的词。

entries.definition: a feeling of worry
done together by several people
a small group of old instruments
an act of playing music for an audience
a small concert by one performer
a public entertainment event

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with an orchestra breathing together, then move to people acting as one.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从整个乐团一起吸气开始，再走到人们如同一人地行动。

normal.en: Con- is together and cert comes from a word for striving, so concert is many efforts made one.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cert 源自表示努力的古词，concert 就是许多努力合成一个。

normal.en: In a concert, a hundred players breathe at the same moment.
normal.cn: 在音乐会上，上百名演奏者会在同一瞬间吸气。

normal.en: In concert with means working in harmony with others.
normal.cn: in concert with 意为与他人和谐协作。

normal.en: A rock concert and a symphony concert share the same name.
normal.cn: 摇滚音乐会与交响音乐会共用同一个名字。

normal.en: Concerto and concert are cousins, both from the idea of harmony.
normal.cn: concerto 与 concert 是表亲，都来自和谐这个意思。

abstract.en: Picture a conductor's hand lifting a whole orchestra at once.
abstract.cn: 想象指挥的手一下把整个乐团提起来。

abstract.en: Picture many strings vibrating into one warm sound.
abstract.cn: 想象许多琴弦振动成一个温暖的声音。

abstract.en: Picture two teams rowing in the same rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象两支队伍按同一节奏划桨。

examples.en: We went to a concert in the park last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚我们去公园听了一场音乐会。

examples.en: The two countries acted in concert to protect the river.
examples.cn: 两国协作保护这条河。

examples.en: The concert hall was full an hour early.
examples.cn: 音乐厅提前一小时就坐满了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concert 记成 con（一起）加 cert（确定）：大家把声音确定在同一个调上，就是音乐会，也是一致协作。

root: 源自意大利语 concerto（一致、和谐），上溯拉丁语 concertare（共同努力），本义是声音和谐一致，后指音乐会与协同行动。

sensesIntro.en: From many instruments sounding as one, to many people acting as one.
sensesIntro.cn: 从许多乐器发出同一个声音，到许多人如同一人地行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole orchestra drawing breath together as the conductor lifts a hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：指挥抬手的一瞬，整个乐团一起吸气。

branches.en: The musical event is the everyday sense of concert.
branches.cn: 音乐活动是 concert 的日常义项。

branches.en: The agreement sense survives in the phrase in concert.
branches.cn: 一致义项保留在 in concert 这个短语中。

branches.en: A concert is public, so it gathers players and listeners.
branches.cn: 音乐会面向公众，因此聚起演奏者与听众。

branches.en: Joint action is harmony applied to work rather than music.
branches.cn: 联合行动是把和谐用于工作而非音乐。

branches.en: Both senses depend on many parts keeping one time.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖许多部分守住同一个节拍。

intro.en: Concert is built on Latin com-, together, plus certare, to strive, through the Italian form concerto.
intro.cn: concert 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 certare（努力）构成，经意大利语 concerto 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The striving base cert- also appears in certain and certify, where it means settled.
latinIntro.cn: 表示努力的词基 cert- 也出现在 certain 与 certify 中，那里意为确定。

items.example: The band plays thirty concerts a year.
items.exampleCN: 这支乐队一年演出三十场。

items.example: They made a concerted effort to save water.
items.exampleCN: 他们共同努力节约用水。

items.example: The group acted concertedly.
items.exampleCN: 这个团体协同行动。

items.meaning: the leading violinist of an orchestra
items.example: The concertmaster tuned the orchestra.
items.exampleCN: 首席为乐团调音。

items.meaning: a person who often attends concerts
items.example: Regular concertgoers know the hall well.
items.exampleCN: 常听音乐会的人很熟悉这座音乐厅。

items.example: She concertizes across Europe each summer.
items.exampleCN: 她每年夏天在欧洲各地巡演。

items.meaning: a small box instrument with bellows
items.example: He played a concertina by the fire.
items.exampleCN: 他在炉火旁拉六角手风琴。

items.meaning: a piece for soloist and orchestra
items.example: The piano concerto was the highlight.
items.exampleCN: 那首钢琴协奏曲是全场亮点。

definition_zh: 让步；妥协；特许权；优惠
definition_en: something you allow in order to end an argument, or a special right given to someone
core_image: 守门人把栏杆抬起一半，让对方先过去
scene: 谈判桌上，双方各自放下一个条件。Each side made a concession before the deal was signed.
sceneCN: 这里 concession 指「让步」（第 1 个义项：为达成协议而让出的一点）；句意是签约前每一方都作了一项让步。

senses.title: A give in an argument
senses.definition: something you agree to give up in order to reach agreement
senses.definitionCN: 为达成协议而同意放弃的东西
senses.example: The union won a small concession on pay.
senses.exampleCN: 工会争取到了薪酬上的一点让步。
senses.why: One side lifts the barrier a little so the other can move.
senses.whyCN: 一方把栏杆抬起一点，好让另一方通过。

senses.title: A special right
senses.definition: the right to sell or use something, often given by a government
senses.definitionCN: 通常由政府授予的销售或使用某物的权利
senses.example: The company holds the mining concession.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司持有采矿特许权。
senses.why: A right granted is also a kind of thing yielded by the stronger side.
senses.whyCN: 被授予的权利，也是强者让出的一种东西。

senses.title: A lower price
senses.definition: a reduced price for students, children or old people
senses.definitionCN: 为学生、儿童或老人提供的减价
senses.example: Students get a concession on tickets.
senses.exampleCN: 学生买票可以享受优惠。
senses.why: The full price is lowered, as if part of the cost were given away.
senses.whyCN: 全价被降低，就像把部分费用让了出去。

intro.en: Concession comes from Latin concessio, a granting, from concedere, to give way or allow.
intro.cn: concession 来自拉丁语 concessio（准许），源自动词 concedere（让路、允许）。

items.en: Cedere meant to go or to yield ground.
items.cn: cedere 意为走或让出地盘。

items.en: Concedere meant to allow or to grant a request.
items.cn: concedere 意为允许或应允请求。

items.en: Concessio named the act of granting something.
items.cn: concessio 指给予某物的行为。

items.en: Old French concession kept the legal sense of a granted right.
items.cn: 古法语 concession 保留了授予权利的法律含义。

items.en: English concession first meant a thing granted or allowed.
items.cn: 英语 concession 最初指被授予或允许的东西。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concession, and the meaning group names other words for yielding or privilege.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concession 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示让出与特权的词。

entries.definition: offered at a reduced price
a line of people moving in order
a statement that you have done wrong
a deal in which each side gives up something
an amount that is permitted
a special right given to a person or group

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a barrier lifted halfway, then move to granted rights and to cheaper tickets.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从抬到一半的栏杆开始，再走到授予的权利与更便宜的票。

normal.en: Concession is the noun of concede, so it is the thing you let go.
normal.cn: concession 是 concede 的名词，所以它就是被你放手的东西。

normal.en: A concession stand sells snacks inside the barrier.
normal.cn: concession stand 就是在栏杆内卖零食的小摊。

normal.en: A mining concession is a right dug out of the ground.
normal.cn: 采矿特许权是从地里挖出来的一项权利。

normal.en: A student concession is a price that steps back for you.
normal.cn: 学生优惠是一张为你后退的价格。

normal.en: Concessive clauses begin with words like although, which also give way.
normal.cn: 让步从句以 although 这类词开头，它们也在让出立场。

abstract.en: Picture a gatekeeper lifting the bar just enough for one person.
abstract.cn: 想象守门人把栏杆抬到刚够一个人通过。

abstract.en: Picture a hand sliding a signed permit across a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把签好的许可证推过桌面。

abstract.en: Picture a ticket stamped a little cheaper.
abstract.cn: 想象一张票被盖上便宜一些的章。

examples.en: The offer included several concessions on working hours.
examples.cn: 这份提议在工作时间上包含了几项让步。

examples.en: The firm won the oil concession for twenty years.
examples.cn: 这家公司赢得了二十年的石油开采特许权。

examples.en: Children over six must pay the full fare, without concession.
examples.cn: 六岁以上儿童须付全价，没有优惠。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concession 记成 con（一起）加 cess（走）加 ion：从自己的立场上走出去一步，就是让步。

root: 源自拉丁语 concedere（com 一起 + cedere 走、让）的名词 concessio，本义是让路、准许，后指让步、特许权与优惠。

sensesIntro.en: From a small step back in an argument, to a right granted, and finally to a price lowered.
sensesIntro.cn: 从争论中后退一小步，到被授予的权利，最后到被降低的价格。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gatekeeper raising the bar halfway so the other side can pass.
core.cn: 核心意象：守门人把栏杆抬起一半，让对方先过去。

branches.en: A give in an argument is the common everyday sense.
branches.cn: 争论中的让步是常见的日常义项。

branches.en: A granted right turns the give into a legal object.
branches.cn: 被授予的权利把让步变成法律对象。

branches.en: A cheaper ticket is a concession in money.
branches.cn: 更便宜的票是金钱上的让步。

branches.en: Both senses describe something handed over by the stronger side.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述强者交出的东西。

branches.en: A right and a discount are both special treatment.
branches.cn: 权利与折扣都是特殊待遇。

intro.en: Concession is built on Latin com-, together, plus cedere, to go, with the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: concession 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、cedere（走）与名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin go base cess- also gives process, access and recession.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的行走词基 cess- 还给出 process、access 与 recession。

items.example: The talks produced several concessions.
items.exampleCN: 谈判产生了多项让步。

items.example: He conceded the point at once.
items.exampleCN: 他立刻承认了那一点。

items.example: Although is a concessive word.
items.exampleCN: although 是一个让步词。

items.example: The bank offered a concessional loan.
items.exampleCN: 银行提供了一笔优惠贷款。

items.example: They run a concessionary fare scheme.
items.exampleCN: 他们实施优惠票价方案。

items.meaning: a person who holds a concession
items.example: The concessionaire runs the park cafe.
items.exampleCN: 特许经营者经营公园咖啡馆。

items.meaning: a line of people moving forward
items.example: A procession moved slowly up the hill.
items.exampleCN: 一支队伍缓缓上山。

items.example: The clause is used concessively.
items.exampleCN: 这个从句被用作让步。

definition_zh: 断定；得出结论；结束；缔结
definition_en: to decide something after considering facts, or to bring something to an end
core_image: 一段长路走到尽头，回望时把整条路线看清
scene: 听完双方陈述，法官合上卷宗。The judge concluded that the evidence was weak.
sceneCN: 这里 conclude 指「断定」（第 1 个义项：根据事实作出判断）；句意是法官断定证据不足。

pos.zh: 断定；得出结论；结束；缔结

senses.title: Reach a judgment
senses.definition: to decide that something is true after thinking about the facts
senses.definitionCN: 在思考事实之后判定某事为真
senses.example: We concluded that the plan was too risky.
senses.exampleCN: 我们断定这个计划风险太大。
senses.why: When the evidence is all in, the mind shuts the case and settles.
senses.whyCN: 证据齐了，心就合上案卷，作出定论。

senses.title: Bring to an end
senses.definition: to finish an event, speech or piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 结束一个活动、演讲或文章
senses.example: The meeting concluded at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 会议在中午结束。
senses.why: To close a matter is the same motion as closing a door.
senses.whyCN: 关闭一件事，和关上一扇门是同一个动作。

senses.title: Arrange a formal agreement
senses.definition: to complete a treaty, deal or agreement formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式完成条约、交易或协议
senses.example: The two countries concluded a trade agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 两国缔结了一项贸易协定。
senses.why: A deal is closed like a box, and once shut it is binding.
senses.whyCN: 交易像箱子一样被合上，一旦合上便有约束力。

intro.en: Conclude comes from Latin concludere, to shut up together, from com-, together, and claudere, to close.
intro.cn: conclude 来自拉丁语 concludere（一起关上），由 com-（一起）与 claudere（关闭）构成。

items.en: Claudere meant to close or to shut.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭或合上。

items.en: Concludere meant to shut something in or to end it.
items.cn: concludere 意为把某物关起来或结束它。

items.en: Conclusio named a closing or a final inference.
items.cn: conclusio 指收尾或最终的推论。

items.en: Old French conclure meant to finish or to decide.
items.cn: 古法语 conclure 意为结束或决定。

items.en: English conclude took both the ending and the reasoning senses.
items.cn: 英语 conclude 同时接纳了结束与推理两种含义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to conclude, and the meaning group names other words for deciding or ending.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 conclude 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示断定与结束的词。

entries.definition: to have something as a part
to keep someone or something out
proving something beyond doubt
to choose after thinking
to bring something to an end
to reach an opinion from evidence

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a case file being closed, then move to a meeting ending and a treaty signed.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从合上案卷开始，再走到会议结束与条约签署。

normal.en: Con- is together and clude is to close, so conclude is to close everything up.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，clude 是关闭，conclude 就是把一切合上。

normal.en: Include and exclude also carry the same closing base.
normal.cn: include 与 exclude 也带着同一个关闭词基。

normal.en: A judge concludes when the evidence has been shut into one story.
normal.cn: 当证据被合进一个说法，法官就作出断定。

normal.en: A speech concludes with a last line, as a box closes with a lid.
normal.cn: 演讲以最后一句话收尾，如同箱子合上盖子。

normal.en: To conclude a deal is to close it so no one can add a term.
normal.cn: 达成交易就是把它合上，谁也不能再加条款。

abstract.en: Picture a thick folder closing on a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一本厚卷宗在桌上合上。

abstract.en: Picture a road reaching its last stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一条路走到最后一块石头。

abstract.en: Picture two hands shaking as a door shuts behind them.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手相握，身后的门合上。

examples.en: The report concluded that the bridge was safe.
examples.cn: 报告断定这座桥是安全的。

examples.en: She concluded her talk with a short story.
examples.cn: 她用一个短故事结束了演讲。

examples.en: The two firms concluded a deal last week.
examples.cn: 两家公司上周达成了一笔交易。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conclude 记成 con（一起）加 clude（关闭）：把事情一起合上，就是结束，也是作出结论。

root: 源自拉丁语 concludere（com 一起 + claudere 关闭），本义是合上、关起来，后引申为结束、缔结与得出结论。

sensesIntro.en: From shutting a case, to closing an event, and finally to sealing an agreement.
sensesIntro.cn: 从合上案卷，到结束一场活动，最后到封定一份协议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long road reaching its end, and the whole route seen at one glance.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条长路走到尽头，回望时一眼看清整条路线。

branches.en: The judgment sense comes from closing the evidence into one view.
branches.cn: 断定义来自把证据合进一个看法。

branches.en: The ending sense is the most literal closing.
branches.cn: 结束义是最字面的合上。

branches.en: A formal deal is closed so that it stands.
branches.cn: 正式交易被合上，才能成立。

branches.en: A speech and an argument both end when the speaker closes them.
branches.cn: 演讲与论证都在说话人合上时结束。

branches.en: Ending and sealing both mean no more changes.
branches.cn: 结束与封定都意味着不再更改。

intro.en: Conclude is built on Latin com-, together, plus claudere, to close.
intro.cn: conclude 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 claudere（关闭）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin close base clud- also gives include, exclude and seclude.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的关闭词基 clud- 还给出 include、exclude 与 seclude。

items.example: The chapter concludes with a question.
items.exampleCN: 这一章以一个问句结束。

items.example: The inquiry concluded in May.
items.exampleCN: 调查在五月结束。

items.example: The concluding remark was brief.
items.exampleCN: 结尾的评语很简短。

items.example: The conclusion follows from the data.
items.exampleCN: 结论由数据得出。

items.example: The evidence was conclusive.
items.exampleCN: 证据是确凿的。

items.example: The test proved it conclusively.
items.exampleCN: 测试确凿地证明了这一点。

items.example: They questioned the conclusiveness of the study.
items.exampleCN: 他们质疑这项研究的决定性。

items.meaning: not leading to a clear result
items.example: The first tests were inconclusive.
items.exampleCN: 最初的测试没有定论。

definition_zh: 结论；结尾；结束；缔结
definition_en: a judgment reached after thinking, or the end of something
core_image: 一篇文章最后一个句号落下的瞬间
scene: 论文写到最后一页，他把所有线索收进一段话。The conclusion ties together every thread of the argument.
sceneCN: 这里 conclusion 指「结尾部分」（第 2 个义项：文章或讲话的最后一段）；句意是结尾把论证的每一条线索都收拢起来。

senses.title: A judgment reached
senses.definition: a decision or opinion formed after considering the facts
senses.definitionCN: 在考虑事实之后形成的决定或看法
senses.example: Her conclusion was based on solid evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 她的结论建立在确凿证据之上。
senses.why: When the reasoning is closed, what remains is the conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 推理合上之后，留下来的就是结论。

senses.title: The end of something
senses.definition: the final part or end of an event or piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 事件或文章的最后部分或终点
senses.example: The conclusion of the speech was moving.
senses.exampleCN: 演讲的结尾很动人。
senses.why: The last part closes the whole, just as a lid closes a box.
senses.whyCN: 最后一部分合上整体，正如盖子合上箱子。

senses.title: A formal agreement
senses.definition: the act of completing a treaty or deal formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式完成条约或交易的行为
senses.example: The conclusion of the peace treaty was welcomed.
senses.exampleCN: 和平条约的缔结受到欢迎。
senses.why: A deal is brought to its close, and that close is named the conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 交易被带到终点，而那个终点就叫 conclusion。

intro.en: Conclusion comes from Latin conclusio, a closing, from concludere, to shut up together.
intro.cn: conclusion 来自拉丁语 conclusio（关闭），源自动词 concludere（一起关上）。

items.en: Claudere meant to close or to shut.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭或合上。

items.en: Concludere meant to shut something in or to finish it.
items.cn: concludere 意为把某物关起来或完成它。

items.en: Conclusio named a closing and also a final inference.
items.cn: conclusio 指收尾，也指最终的推论。

items.en: Old French conclusion kept both the ending and the reasoning senses.
items.cn: 古法语 conclusion 同时保留结束与推理两种含义。

items.en: English conclusion first meant the end of a speech or argument.
items.cn: 英语 conclusion 最初指演讲或论证的结尾。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to conclusion, and the meaning group names other words for a result or an ending.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 conclusion 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示结果与结尾的词。

entries.definition: proving something beyond doubt
a state of not understanding
the act of including something
a decision made by a court or judge
the last part of a story or event
what happens because of something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a final full stop, then move to the verdict of a court and the closing of a treaty.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从最后一个句号开始，再走到法庭裁决与条约缔结。

normal.en: Conclusion is the noun of conclude, so it is the closed result.
normal.cn: conclusion 是 conclude 的名词，所以它就是被合上的结果。

normal.en: In conclusion means the closing words are coming now.
normal.cn: in conclusion 意为收尾的话现在要来了。

normal.en: A conclusion is a verdict built out of reasons.
normal.cn: 结论是用理由搭建起来的裁决。

normal.en: The conclusion of a treaty is its formal closing.
normal.cn: 条约的 conclusion 就是它正式的缔结。

normal.en: Jump to a conclusion and you close the case too early.
normal.cn: 急于下结论，就是太早合上案卷。

abstract.en: Picture the last full stop landing on a white page.
abstract.cn: 想象最后一个句号落在白纸上。

abstract.en: Picture a judge setting down a folder and looking up.
abstract.cn: 想象法官放下卷宗，抬起头。

abstract.en: Picture two pens signing the final page of a treaty.
abstract.cn: 想象两支笔在条约最后一页签字。

examples.en: The evidence led them to a clear conclusion.
examples.cn: 证据让他们得出了明确的结论。

examples.en: In conclusion, the plan needs more time.
examples.cn: 总之，这个计划需要更多时间。

examples.en: The conclusion of the film left everyone silent.
examples.cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都沉默了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conclusion 记成 con（一起）加 clus（关闭）加 ion：把事情合起来定下，就是结论与结尾。

root: 源自拉丁语 concludere（com 一起 + claudere 关闭）的名词 conclusio，本义是关闭、收尾，后指结论、结尾与缔结。

sensesIntro.en: From the case being closed on a judgment, to the last page, and finally to a treaty brought to its close.
sensesIntro.cn: 从案卷在判决上合起，到最后一页，最后到被带到终点的条约。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the moment the final full stop lands on the page.
core.cn: 核心意象：最后一个句号落在纸上的瞬间。

branches.en: A judgment is the mental result of closing the argument.
branches.cn: 结论是合上论证之后的思维结果。

branches.en: The ending is the physical last part of a text or event.
branches.cn: 结尾是文章或活动最后的具体部分。

branches.en: A treaty is concluded, and that act is its conclusion.
branches.cn: 条约被缔结，而这一行为就是 conclusion。

branches.en: Reasoning and writing both arrive at a closing point.
branches.cn: 推理与写作都抵达一个收束点。

branches.en: An ending and a sealed deal both refuse further change.
branches.cn: 结尾与封定的交易都拒绝再改。

intro.en: Conclusion is built on Latin com-, together, plus claudere, to close, with the noun ending -sion.
intro.cn: conclusion 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、claudere（关闭）与名词词尾 -sion 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin close base clus- also gives exclusion, inclusion and seclusion.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的关闭词基 clus- 还给出 exclusion、inclusion 与 seclusion。

items.example: The two studies reached different conclusions.
items.exampleCN: 两项研究得出了不同的结论。

items.example: We conclude that the method works.
items.exampleCN: 我们断定这个方法有效。

items.example: There is conclusive proof of the change.
items.exampleCN: 有确凿证据表明这一变化。

items.example: The cause was conclusively identified.
items.exampleCN: 原因被确凿地确认了。

items.example: The second test was inconclusive.
items.exampleCN: 第二次测试没有定论。

items.example: The conclusiveness of the data was debated.
items.exampleCN: 数据的决定性受到争论。

items.example: The concluding chapter is short.
items.exampleCN: 结尾的一章很短。

items.example: The deal was concluded in June.
items.exampleCN: 交易在六月达成。
